supervening, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) or G3571 (νύξ) being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night feminine singular participle of a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to go);
tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510 (εἰμί); for subsistence, i.e. needful perhaps from the same as G1966 (ἐπιοῦσα);

term: fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon
definition: to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4098 (πίπτω);
to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4141 (πλήσσω);
to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4155 (πνίγω);
to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully) from G1909 (ἐπί) and potheo (to yearn);
a longing for from G1971 (ἐπιποθέω);
yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the latter part of G1971 (ἐπιποθέω);
intense longing from G1971 (ἐπιποθέω);
to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4198 (πορεύομαι);
to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4476 (ῥαφίς);
to throw upon (literally or figuratively) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4496 (ῥίπτω);
remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent from G1909 (ἐπί) and some form of the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);
a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4621 (σῖτος);
to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4649 (σκοπός);
to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with  from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4637 (σκηνόω);
to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);
to oversee; by implication, to beware from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4648 (σκοπέω);

term: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation
definition: inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate" from G1980 (ἐπισκέπτομαι);
a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of G1983 (ἐπισκοπέω));
to draw over, i.e. (with G203 (ἀκροβυστία) implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4685 (σπάω);
to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with apparently a middle voice of G2186 (ἐφίστημι) (with G3563 (νοῦς) implied);
an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher) from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G2476 (ἵστημι);
to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4724 (στέλλω);
intelligent from G1987 (ἐπίσταμαι);
to support further, i.e. reestablish from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4741 (στηρίζω);
a written message from G1989 (ἐπιστέλλω);
to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4750 (στόμα);
to revert (literally, figuratively or morally) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4762 (στρέφω);
reversion, i.e. morally, revolution from G1994 (ἐπιστρέφω);
to collect upon the same place from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4863 (συνάγω);
a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship) from G1996 (ἐπισυνάγω);
to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4936 (συντρέχω);

term: that which cometh upon, + raising up
definition: a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly) from the middle voice of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G4921 (συνιστάω);
figuratively, insecure from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to trip);
to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2480 (ἰσχύω);
to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4987 (σωρεύω);
an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness from G2004 (ἐπιτάσσω);
to arrange upon, i.e. order from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5021 (τάσσω);
to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5055 (τελέω);
serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite from (enough);

term: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound
definition: to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5087 (τίθημι);
to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5091 (τιμάω);
properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008 (ἐπιτιμάω)) of a penalty from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G5092 (τιμή);

term: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer
definition: to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
permission, i.e. (by implication) full power from G2010 (ἐπιτρέπω);
a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5158 (τρόπος) (in the sense of G2011 (ἐπιτροπή));
to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5177 (τυγχάνω);
to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5316 (φαίνω);
a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future) from G2016 (ἐπιφανής);
conspicuous, i.e. (figuratively) memorable from G2014 (ἐπιφαίνω);
to illuminate (figuratively) a form of G2014 (ἐπιφαίνω);
to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5342 (φέρω);
to call at something, i.e. exclaim from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5455 (φωνέω);

term: begin to dawn, X draw on
definition: to begin to grow light a form of G2017 (ἐπιφαύω);
to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5495 (χείρ);
from G1909 (ἐπί) and (to pour);
to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5524 (χορηγέω);
contribution from G2023 (ἐπιχορηγέω);
to smear over from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5548 (χρίω);
to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3618 (οἰκοδομέω);
to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel from G1909 (ἐπί) and (to urge);
to name further, i.e. denominate from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3687 (ὀνομάζω);
to inspect, i.e. watch from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
a looker-on from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
a word from G2036 (ἔπω);
above the sky from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3772 (οὐρανός);
seven a primary number;
seven times adverb from G2033 (ἑπτά);
seven times a thousand from G2034 (ἑπτάκις) and G5507 (χίλιοι);

term: answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell
definition: to speak or say (by word or writing) a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from G2046 (ἐρέω), G4483 (ῥέω), and G5346 (φημί));
beloved; Erastus, a Christian from (to love);

term: commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work
definition: to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc. middle voice from G2041 (ἔργον);
occupation; by implication, profit, pains from G2040 (ἐργάτης);
a toiler; figuratively, a teacher from G2041 (ἔργον);
toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act from a primary (but obsolete) (to work);
to stimulate (especially to anger) from a presumed prolonged form of G2054 (ἔρις);
to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast of obscure affinity;
to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out of uncertain affinity;
to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate apparently from G2046 (ἐρέω) (through the idea of inquiry);
an alternate for G2036 (ἔπω) in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say probably a fuller form of G4483 (ῥέω);
solitude (concretely) from G2048 (ἔρημος);
of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, G5561 (χώρα) being implied)

term: (bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought
definition: to lay waste (literally or figuratively) from G2048 (ἔρημος);
despoliation from G2049 (ἐρημόω);
to wrangle from G2054 (ἔρις);
properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction perhaps as the same as G2042 (ἐρεθίζω);
wool of obscure affinity;
a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling of uncertain affinity;
a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person) from G2056 (ἔριφος);
a kid or (genitive case) goat perhaps from the same as G2053 (ἔριον) (through the idea of hairiness);
Hermas, a Christian probably from G2060 (Ἑρμῆς);
translation from the same as G2059 (ἑρμηνεύω);
to translate from a presumed derivative of G2060 (Ἑρμῆς) (as the god of language);
Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian perhaps from G2046 (ἐρέω);
born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian from G2060 (Ἑρμῆς) and G1096 (γίνομαι);
a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare H07431)) a small animal neuter of a derivative of (to creep);
of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281 (θάλασσα)) the Red Sea

term: accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set
definition: to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively) middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) , or (active) , which do not otherwise occur);
to interrogate; by implication, to request apparently from G2046 (ἐρέω) (compare G2045 (ἐρευνάω));
dress from (to clothe);
clothing (concretely) from a derivative of G2066 (ἐσθής);
used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by G5315 (φάγω); to eat (usually literal) strengthened for a primary (to eat);
Esli, an Israelite of Hebrew origin (probably for H0454);

term: are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us
definition: we are first person plural indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);

term: shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn
definition: will be future of G1510 (εἰμί);
a mirror (for looking into) from G1519 (εἰς) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (G5610 (ὥρα) being implied)
Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite of Hebrew origin (H02696);
ye are second person plural present indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);

term: are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle
definition: he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are third person singular present indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);
be thou; also , third person of the same; let them be second person singular present imperative of G1510 (εἰμί);

term: ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost
definition: farthest, final (of place or time) a superlative probably from G2192 (ἔχω) (in the sense of contiguity);
finally, i.e. (with G2192 (ἔχω)) at the extremity of life adverb from G2078 (ἔσχατος);
inside (as preposition or adjective) from G1519 (εἰς);
from inside; also used as equivalent to G2080 (ἔσω) (inside) from G2080 (ἔσω);
interior comparative of G2080 (ἔσω);
a comrade from (a clansman);
other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner from G2087 (ἕτερος) and G1100 (γλῶσσα);
to instruct differently from G2087 (ἕτερος) and G1320 (διδάσκαλος);
to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly from a compound of G2087 (ἕτερος) and G2218 (ζυγός);

term: altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange
definition: (an-, the) other or different of uncertain affinity;
differently adverb from G2087 (ἕτερος);

term: after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet
definition: "yet," still (of time or degree) perhaps akin to G2094 (ἔτος);
to prepare from G2092 (ἕτοιμος);
preparation from G2090 (ἑτοιμάζω);
adjusted, i.e. ready from an old noun (fitness);
in readiness adverb from G2092 (ἕτοιμος);
a year apparently a primary word;
(adverbially) well neuter of a primary (good);
Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman of Hebrew origin (H02332);

term: declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel)
definition: to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel from G2095 (εὖ) and G32 (ἄγγελος);
a good message, i.e. the gospel from the same as G2097 (εὐαγγελίζω);
a preacher of the gospel from G2097 (εὐαγγελίζω);
to gratify entirely from G2101 (εὐάρεστος);
fully agreeable from G2095 (εὖ) and G701 (ἀρεστός);
quite agreeably adverb from G2101 (εὐάρεστος);
good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian from G2095 (εὖ) and G1014 (βούλομαι);
well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous from G2095 (εὖ) and G1096 (γίνομαι);
a clear sky, i.e. fine weather feminine from G2095 (εὖ) and the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) (as the god of the weather);

term: think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing
definition: to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing) from G2095 (εὖ) and G1380 (δοκέω);

term: desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good
definition: satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose from a presumed compound of G2095 (εὖ) and the base of G1380 (δοκέω);
beneficence (genitive case or specially) from G2110 (εὐεργέτης);
to be philanthropic from G2110 (εὐεργέτης);
a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist from G2095 (εὖ) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);
well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

term: anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway
definition: directly, i.e. at once or soon adverb from G2117 (εὐθύς);
to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct from G2117 (εὐθύς) and G1408 (δρόμος);
to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully from G2115 (εὔθυμος);

term: of good cheer, the more cheerfully
definition: in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful from G2095 (εὖ) and G2372 (θυμός);
to straighten (level); technically, to steer from G2117 (εὐθύς);

term: anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway
definition: straight, i.e. (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once perhaps from G2095 (εὖ) and G5087 (τίθημι);
rectitude from G2117 (εὐθύς);
to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure from G2121 (εὔκαιρος);
a favorable occasion from G2121 (εὔκαιρος);
well-timed, i.e. opportune from G2095 (εὖ) and G2540 (καιρός);
opportunely adverb from G2121 (εὔκαιρος);
better for toil, i.e. more facile comparative of a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G2873 (κόπος);
properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely) from G2126 (εὐλαβής);
to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence middle voice from G2126 (εὐλαβής);
taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious) from G2095 (εὖ) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper) from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3056 (λόγος);
adorable from G2127 (εὐλογέω);

term: blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech
definition: fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess from the same as G2127 (εὐλογέω);
good at imparting, i.e. liberal from G2095 (εὖ) and a presumed derivative of G3330 (μεταδίδωμι);
victorious; Eunice, a Jewess from G2095 (εὖ) and G3529 (νίκη);
to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3563 (νοῦς);
kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty from the same as G2132 (εὐνοέω);
to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried) from G2135 (εὐνοῦχος);
a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer) from (a bed) and G2192 (ἔχω);
fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman from the same as G2137 (εὐοδόω);
to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G3598 (ὁδός);
good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint from G2095 (εὖ) and G3982 (πείθω);

well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case) from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of a presumed compound of G4012 (περί) and G2476 (ἵστημι);
well-doing, i.e. beneficence from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4160 (ποιέω);
(intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means from a compound of G2090 (ἑτοιμάζω) and the base of G4197 (πορεία);
pecuniary resources from the same as G2141 (εὐπορέω);
good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4241 (πρέπω);
well-received, i.e. approved, favorable from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G4327 (προσδέχομαι);
sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service) from G2095 (εὖ) and the same as G4332 (προσεδρεύω);
to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G4383 (πρόσωπον);
to find (literally or figuratively) a prolonged form of a primary , which (together with another cognate form) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect;
a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter from (the east wind) and G2830 (κλύδων);
spacious from (wide) and G5561 (χώρα);
piety; specially, the gospel scheme from G2152 (εὐσεβής);
to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support) from G2152 (εὐσεβής);
well-reverent, i.e. pious from G2095 (εὖ) and G4576 (σέβομαι);
piously adverb from G2152 (εὐσεβής);
well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant from G2095 (εὖ) and the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);
well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic from G2095 (εὖ) and G4698 (σπλάγχνον);
decorously adverb from G2158 (εὐσχήμων);
decorousness from G2158 (εὐσχήμων);
well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank) from G2095 (εὖ) and G4976 (σχῆμα);
in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely) adverb from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of (to stretch);
witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of the base of G5157 (τροπή) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose);
well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5177 (τυγχάνω);
good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute) from G2163 (εὔφημος);
well spoken of, i.e. reputable from G2095 (εὖ) and G5345 (φήμη);
to bear well, i.e. be fertile from G2095 (εὖ) and G5409 (φορέω);

term: fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice
definition: to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice from G2095 (εὖ) and G5424 (φρήν);
Euphrates, a river of Asia of foreign origin (compare H06578);
joyfulness from the same as G2165 (εὐφραίνω);
to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal from G2170 (εὐχάριστος);
gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship) from G2170 (εὐχάριστος);
well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5483 (χαρίζομαι);
properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation from G2172 (εὔχομαι);
to wish; by implication, to pray to God middle voice of a primary verb;
easily used, i.e. useful from G2095 (εὖ) and G5543 (χρηστός);
to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and G5590 (ψυχή);
good-scentedness, i.e. fragrance from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G3605 (ὄζω);
properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand from G2095 (εὖ) and G3686 (ὄνομα);
to spring upon from G1909 (ἐπί) and G242 (ἅλλομαι);
upon one occasion (only) from G1909 (ἐπί) and G530 (ἅπαξ);
Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus from G2181 (Ἔφεσος);
an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus from G2181 (Ἔφεσος);
Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor probably of foreign origin;
a discoverer, i.e. contriver from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G2147 (εὑρίσκω);
diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families from G2184 (ἐφήμερος);
for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2250 (ἡμέρα);
to arrive upon, i.e. extend to from G1909 (ἐπί) and a cognate of G2240 (ἥκω);

term: --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over)
definition: to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal);  from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2476 (ἵστημι);
Ephraim, a place in Palestine of Hebrew origin (H0669 or better H06085);
be opened! of Chaldee origin (H06606);
hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition feminine of G2190 (ἐχθρός);

Pacatianian, a section of Phrygia feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation;

to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete from G3820 (παλαιός);
another form for G906 (βάλλω)); wrestling from (to vibrate;

(adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand probably from the same as G3823 (πάλη) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition);

an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai) from the same as G3829 (πανδοχεῖον);
a mass-meeting, i.e. (figuratively) universal companionship from G3956 (πᾶς) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά);
with the whole family adverb from G3956 (πᾶς) and G3624 (οἶκος);
full armor ("panoply") from a compound of G3956 (πᾶς) and G3696 (ὅπλον);
adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry from G3835 (πανοῦργος);
all-working, i.e. adroit (shrewd) from G3956 (πᾶς) and G2041 (ἔργον);
from all directions adverb (of source) from G3837 (πανταχοῦ);
universally genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of G3956 (πᾶς);
full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion) from G3956 (πᾶς) and G5056 (τέλος);
wholly adverb (of manner) from G3956 (πᾶς);

term: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely
definition: entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event adverb from G3956 (πᾶς);

definition: properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of) a primary preposition;

violation from G3845 (παραβαίνω);
a violator from G3845 (παραβαίνω);
to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty) from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G971 (βιάζω);
a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage from G3846 (παραβάλλω);
to misconsult, i.e. disregard from G3844 (παρά) and the middle voice of G1011 (βουλεύω);
a mandate from G3853 (παραγγέλλω);
to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

definition: to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy from G3844 (παρά) and G1165 (δειγματίζω);
a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise") of Oriental origin (compare H06508);

misemployment, i.e. meddlesomeness from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G1304 (διατρίβω);

contrary to expectation, i.e. extraordinary ("paradox") from G3844 (παρά) and G1391 (δόξα) (in the sense of seeming);
transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law from G3860 (παραδίδωμι);

along the sea, i.e. maritime (lacustrine) from G3844 (παρά) and G2281 (θάλασσα);
to overlook or disregard from G3844 (παρά) and G2334 (θεωρέω);
a deposit, i.e. (figuratively) trust from G3908 (παρατίθημι);
to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course) from G3844 (παρά) and G134 (αἰνέω);

to sit down near from G3844 (παρά) and G2523 (καθίζω);

term: beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray
definition: to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation) from G3844 (παρά) and G2564 (καλέω);
to cover alongside, i.e. veil (figuratively) from G3844 (παρά) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

imploration, hortation, solace from G3870 (παρακαλέω);
an intercessor, consoler

to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within) from G3844 (παρά) and G2955 (κύπτω);

transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);
to misreckon, i.e. delude from G3844 (παρά) and G3049 (λογίζομαι);
as if dissolved, i.e. "paralytic" from a derivative of G3886 (παραλύω);

definition: to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled) from G3844 (παρά) and G3089 (λύω);

irritation from G3893 (παραπικραίνω);
to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize from G3844 (παρά) and G4098 (πίπτω);
to sail near from G3844 (παρά) and G4126 (πλέω);
close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost neuter of a compound of G3844 (παρά) and the base of G4139 (πλησίον) (as adverb);

incitement (to good), or dispute (in anger) from G3947 (παροξύνω) ("paroxysm");

to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous) from a derivative of G4078 (πήγνυμι) (meaning thick);
a shackle for the feet ultimately from G4228 (πούς);
level (as easy for the feet) from a derivative of G4228 (πούς) (meaning the ground);

to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice from a compound of G3982 (πείθω) and G757 (ἄρχω);

"pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave from the same as G3993 (πένης) (through the idea of pinching toil;

term: + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken
definition: to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years) from G4253 (πρό) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate from G4253 (πρό) and G906 (βάλλω);
relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem from G4263 (πρόβατον);
something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively) probably neuter of a presumed derivative of G4260 (προβαίνω);
to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate from G4253 (πρό) and a reduplicated form of G971 (βιάζω);
to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance from G4253 (πρό) and G991 (βλέπω);
to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired from G4253 (πρό) and G1096 (γίνομαι);
to know beforehand, i.e. foresee from G4253 (πρό) and G1097 (γινώσκω);
forethought from G4267 (προγινώσκω);
an ancestor, (grand-)parent from G4266 (προγίνομαι);

term: before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime)
definition: to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe from G4253 (πρό) and G1125 (γράφω);
plain before all men, i.e. obvious from G4253 (πρό) and G1212 (δῆλος);
to give before the other party has given from G4253 (πρό) and G1325 (δίδωμι);
a surrender from G4272 (προδίδωμι) (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands);
a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor) from the alternate of G4390 (προτρέχω);
foresee from G4253 (πρό) and G1492 (εἴδω);
to hope in advance of other confirmation from G4253 (πρό) and G1679 (ἐλπίζω);
to say already, to predict from G4253 (πρό) and G2036 (ἔπω);
to commence already from G4253 (πρό) and G1728 (ἐνάρχομαι);
to promise of old middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G1861 (ἐπαγγέλλω);
used as alternate of G4277 (προέπω); to say already, predict from G4253 (πρό) and G2046 (ἐρέω);

term: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on
definition: to go onward, precede (in place or time) from G4253 (πρό) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively) from G4253 (πρό) and G2090 (ἑτοιμάζω);
to announce glad news in advance middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2097 (εὐαγγελίζω);
to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2192 (ἔχω);
to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference from G4253 (πρό) and G2233 (ἡγέομαι);
a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God from G4388 (προτίθεμαι);
fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with G2250 (ἡμέρα) implied) a designated day from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

term: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind
definition: predisposition, i.e. alacrity from G4289 (πρόθυμος);
forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity from G4253 (πρό) and G2372 (θυμός);
with alacrity adverb from G4289 (πρόθυμος);
to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise from G4253 (πρό) and G2476 (ἵστημι);
to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2564 (καλέω);
to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise from G4253 (πρό) and G2605 (καταγγέλλω);
to prepare in advance from G4253 (πρό) and G2675 (καταρτίζω);
to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward) from G4253 (πρό) and G2749 (κεῖμαι);
to herald (i.e. proclaim) in advance from G4253 (πρό) and G2784 (κηρύσσω);
progress, i.e. advancement (subjectively or objectively) from G4298 (προκόπτω);

term: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax
definition: to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along) from G4253 (πρό) and G2875 (κόπτω);
a prejudgment (prejudice), i.e. prepossession from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G2919 (κρίνω);
to ratify previously from G4253 (πρό) and G2964 (κυρόω);
to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise from G4253 (πρό) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn from G4253 (πρό) and G3004 (λέγω);
to be a witness in advance i.e. predict from G4253 (πρό) and G3143 (μαρτύρομαι);
to premeditate from G4253 (πρό) and G3191 (μελετάω);
to care (anxiously) in advance from G4253 (πρό) and G3309 (μεριμνάω);
to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself) from G4253 (πρό) and G3539 (νοιέω);
forethought, i.e. provident care or supply from G4306 (προνοέω);
to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view from G4253 (πρό) and G3708 (ὁράω);
to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine from G4253 (πρό) and G3724 (ὁρίζω);
to undergo hardship previously from G4253 (πρό) and G3958 (πάσχω);

term: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth
definition: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel from G4253 (πρό) and G3992 (πέμπω);
falling forward, i.e. headlong (figuratively, precipitate) from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G4098 (πίπτω);
to precede (as guide or herald) from G4253 (πρό) and G4198 (πορεύομαι);

term: about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in)
definition: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated) a strengthened form of G4253 (πρό);
a fore-sabbath, i.e. the Sabbath-eve from G4253 (πρό) and G4521 (σάββατον);
to address, i.e. salute by name from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά) (mean to harangue);
to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach from G4314 (πρός) and G71 (ἄγω);
admission from G4317 (προσάγω) (compare G72 (ἀγωγή));
to ask repeatedly (importune), i.e. solicit from G4314 (πρός) and G154 (αἰτέω);
to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat) from G4314 (πρός) and G305 (ἀναβαίνω);
to expend further from G4314 (πρός) and G355 (ἀναλίσκω);
to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully from G4314 (πρός) and G378 (ἀναπληρόω);
to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult from G4314 (πρός) and G394 (ἀνατίθεμαι);
to menace additionally from G4314 (πρός) and G546 (ἀπειλέω);
to expend additionally from G4314 (πρός) and G1159 (δαπανάω);
to require additionally, i.e. want further from G4314 (πρός) and G1189 (δέομαι);
to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience) from G4314 (πρός) and G1209 (δέχομαι);

term: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for
definition: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await from G4314 (πρός) and dokeuo (to watch);
apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated from G4328 (προσδοκάω);
to permit further progress from G4314 (πρός) and G1439 (ἐάω);
to approach near from G4314 (πρός) and G1448 (ἐγγίζω);
to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant from a compound of G4314 (πρός) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);
to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides from G4314 (πρός) and G2038 (ἐργάζομαι);

term: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto)
definition: to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to from G4314 (πρός) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
prayer (worship); by implication, an oratory (chapel) from G4336 (προσεύχομαι);
to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship from G4314 (πρός) and G2172 (εὔχομαι);

term: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard
definition: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to from G4314 (πρός) and G2192 (ἔχω);
to peg to, i.e. spike fast from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G2247 (ἧλος);
an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte") from the alternate of G4334 (προσέρχομαι);

term: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal
definition: for the occasion only, i.e. temporary from G4314 (πρός) and G2540 (καιρός);
to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite middle voice from G4314 (πρός) and G2564 (καλέω);

term: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)
definition: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor) from G4314 (πρός) and G2594 (καρτερέω);
persistancy from G4342 (προσκαρτερέω);
something for the head, i.e. a cushion neuter of a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G2776 (κεφαλή);
to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with from G4314 (πρός) and G2820 (κληρόω);
a leaning towards, i.e. (figuratively) proclivity (favoritism) from a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G2827 (κλίνω);
to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere from G4314 (πρός) and G2853 (κολλάω);
a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy from G4350 (προσκόπτω);
a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin from G4350 (προσκόπτω);
to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively) from G4314 (πρός) and G2875 (κόπτω);
to roll towards, i.e. block against from G4314 (πρός) and G2947 (κυλιόω);

to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore) from G4314 (πρός) and a probable derivative of G2965 (κύων) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand);
an adorer from G4352 (προσκυνέω);
to talk to, i.e. converse with from G4314 (πρός) and G2980 (λαλέω);
to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality) from G4314 (πρός) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
admission from G4355 (προσλαμβάνω);

term: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with)
definition: to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in from G4314 (πρός) and G3306 (μένω);
to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of the same as G3730 (ὁρμή) (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull);
to be indebted additionally from G4314 (πρός) and G3784 (ὀφείλω);
to feel indignant at from G4314 (πρός) and a form of (to be vexed with something irksome);
hungering further, i.e. intensely hungry from G4314 (πρός) and the same as G3983 (πεινάω);
to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross) from G4314 (πρός) and G4078 (πήγνυμι);
to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm) from G4314 (πρός) and G4098 (πίπτω);
to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing) middle voice from G4314 (πρός) and G4160 (ποιέω);
to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as G4313 (προπορεύομαι)) from G4314 (πρός) and G4198 (πορεύομαι);
to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood) from G4314 (πρός) and G4486 (ῥήγνυμι);
to arrange towards, i.e. (figuratively) enjoin from G4314 (πρός) and G5021 (τάσσω);
a patroness, i.e. assistant feminine of a derivative of G4291 (προΐστημι);

term: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more
definition: to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat from G4314 (πρός) and G5087 (τίθημι);
to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join from G4314 (πρός) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (ὀψάριον)) neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5315 (φάγω);
previously (recently) slain (fresh), i.e. (figuratively) lately made from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G4969 (σφάζω);
recently adverb from G4372 (πρόσφατος);

term: bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to
definition: to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat from G4314 (πρός) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);
friendly towards, i.e. acceptable from a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5368 (φιλέω);
presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice from G4374 (προσφέρω);
to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon from G4314 (πρός) and G5455 (φωνέω);
a shedding forth, i.e. affusion from a comparative of G4314 (πρός) and (to pour);
to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve) from G4314 (πρός) and (to touch);
to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality from G4381 (προσωπολήπτης);
an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality from G4383 (πρόσωπον) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
partiality, i.e. favoritism from G4381 (προσωπολήπτης);

term: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence
definition: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person from G4314 (πρός) and (the visage, from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι));
to pre-arrange, i.e. prescribe from G4253 (πρό) and G5021 (τάσσω);
to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging) from G4253 (πρό) and (to stretch);
previously neuter of G4387 (πρότερος) as adverb (with or without the article);
prior or previous comparative of G4253 (πρό);
to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine) middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G5087 (τίθημι);
to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede from G4253 (πρό) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously from G4253 (πρό) and G5225 (ὑπάρχω);
an outward showing, i.e. pretext from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5316 (φαίνω);
to bear forward, i.e. produce from G4253 (πρό) and G5342 (φέρω);
prediction (scriptural or other) from G4396 (προφήτης) ("prophecy");
to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office from G4396 (προφήτης);
a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5346 (φημί);
pertaining to a foreteller ("prophetic") from G4396 (προφήτης);
a female foreteller or an inspired woman feminine of G4396 (προφήτης);
to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate from G4253 (πρό) and G5348 (φθάνω);
to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5495 (χείρ);
to elect in advance from G4253 (πρό) and G5500 (χειροτονέω);
before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian from G4253 (πρό) and G5525 (χορός);
the stern of a ship feminine of (hindmost);
at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch adverb from G4253 (πρό);
day-dawn feminine of a derivative of G4404 (πρωΐ) as noun;
dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season) from G4404 (πρωΐ);
pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal from G4404 (πρωΐ);
the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel feminine of a presumed derivative of G4253 (πρό) as noun;
to be first (in rank or influence) from G4413 (πρῶτος);
a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council from G4413 (πρῶτος) and G2515 (καθέδρα);
a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals from G4413 (πρῶτος) and G2828 (κλισία);

term: before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all)
definition: firstly (in time, place, order, or importance) neuter of G4413 (πρῶτος) as adverb (with or without G3588 (ὁ));

term: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former
definition: foremost (in time, place, order or importance) contracted superlative of G4253 (πρό);
one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion) from G4413 (πρῶτος) and G2476 (ἵστημι);
primogeniture (as a privilege) from G4416 (πρωτότοκος);
first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively) from G4413 (πρῶτος) and the alternate of G5088 (τίκτω);
to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation) a form of G4098 (πίπτω);
the heel (figuratively) of uncertain derivation;
a winglet, i.e. (figuratively) extremity (top corner) neuter of a presumed derivative of G4420 (πτέρυξ);
a wing from a derivative of G4072 (πέτομαι) (meaning a feather);
a bird contraction for G4071 (πετεινόν);
to scare probably akin to the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω) (through the idea of causing to fall) or to G4072 (πέτομαι) (through that of causing to fly away);
alarm from G4422 (πτοέω);
Ptolemais, a place in Palestine from (Ptolemy, after whom it was named);
a winnowing-fork (as scattering like spittle) from G4429 (πτύω);
to frighten from a presumed derivative of G4429 (πτύω) (and thus akin to G4422 (πτοέω));
saliva from G4429 (πτύω);
and thus apparently allied to G4072 (πέτομαι) through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare G3961 (πατέω)); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll probably akin to (to spread;
to spit a primary verb (compare G4428 (πτύσσω));
a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion) from the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω);
a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively) from the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω);
beggary, i.e. indigence (literally or figuratively) from G4433 (πτωχεύω);
to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively) from G4434 (πτωχός);

akin to G4422 (πτοέω) and the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω)); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas G3993 (πένης) properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed) from (to crouch);
the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing) from a primary (the fist as a weapon);
a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying) from (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located);
clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently from the same as G4635 (σκηνοποιός);
to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively) from a derivative of the same as G4435 (πυγμή);
a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively) apparently a primary word;
a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule from G4439 (πύλη);

to question, i.e. ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from G2065 (ἐρωτάω), which properly means a request as a favor; and from G154 (αἰτέω), which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from G2212 (ζητέω), which implies a search for something hidden; and from G1189 (δέομαι), which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence) middle voice prolonged from a primary (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses);
"fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning) a primary word;
a fire (concretely) from G4442 (πῦρ);
a tower or castle apparently a primary word ("burgh");
to be on fire, i.e. (specially), to have a fever from G4443 (πυρά);
inflamed, i.e. (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever) from G4445 (πυρέσσω);
fiery, i.e. (by implication) flaming from G4443 (πυρά);

term: burn, fiery, be on fire, try
definition: to kindle, i.e. (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust) from G4442 (πῦρ);
to redden (intransitively) from G4450 (πυῤῥός);
fire-like, i.e. (specially), flame- colored from G4442 (πῦρ);
ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test) from G4448 (πυρόω);

term: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See G3369 (μηδέπω), G3380 (μήπω), G3764 (οὐδέπω), G3768 (οὔπω), G4455 (πώποτε).
definition: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative. See G3369 (μηδέπω), G3380 (μήπω), G3764 (οὐδέπω), G3768 (οὔπω), G4455 (πώποτε). another form of the base of G4458 (-πώς);
to barter (as a pedlar), i.e. to sell probably ultimately from (to be busy, to trade);
a "foal" or "filly", i.e. (specially), a young ass apparently a primary word;

term: at any time, + never (…to any man), + yet, never man
definition: at any time, i.e. (with negative particle) at no time from G4452 (-πω) and G4218 (ποτέ);
to petrify, i.e. (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous) apparently from (a kind of stone);
stupidity or callousness from G4456 (πωρόω);
an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition adverb from the base of G4225 (πού);
an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much! adverb from the base of G4226 (ποῦ);
Raab (i.e. Rachab), a Canaanitess of Hebrew origin (G7343);
my master, i.e Rabbi, as an official title of honor of Hebrew origin (H07227 with pronominal suffix);
corresponding to G4461 (ῥαββί) of Chaldee origin;
to strike with a stick, i.e. bastinado from G4464 (ῥάβδος);

Aharon, the brother of Moses of uncertain derivation;

term: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.
definition: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for H185 (אַוָּה);
Uel, and Israelite from H176 (אוֹ) and H410 (אֵל); wish of God;
properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar) from the same as H1 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name);
Obil, an Ishmaelite probably from H56 (אָבַל); mournful;
a stream or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of H2988 (יָבָל));
a poker (for turning or gathering embers) from an unused root meaning to rake together;
turnings (i.e. occasions); (adverb) on account of or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181 (אוּד);

term: covet, (greatly) desire, be desirous, long, lust (after).
definition: to wish for a primitive root;
to extend or mark out a primitive root;
longing from H183 (אָוָה);
Uzai, an Israelite perhaps by permutation for H5813 (עֻזִּי), strong;
Uzal, a son of Joktan of uncertain derivation;
lamentation; also interjectionally Oh! probably from H183 (אָוָה) (in the sense of crying out after);
Evi, a Midianitish chief probably from H183 (אָוָה); desirous;
{lamentation; also interjectionally Oh!} feminine of H188 (אוֹי)
(figuratively) silly from an unused root (meaning to be perverse);
Evil-Merodak, a Babylonian king of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak;
the body (as being rolled together); also powerful from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong;

term: if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.
definition: if not; hence perhaps or (shortened) אֻלַי; from H176 (אוֹ);
the Ulai (or Eulaeus), a river of Persia of Persian derivation;
silly, foolish; hence (morally) impious from H191 (אֱוִיל);
a vestibule (as bound to the building) or (shortened), אֻלָם ; from H481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of tying);
Ulam, the name of two Israelites appar, from H481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of dumbness); solitary;

term: as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.
definition: however or on the contrary apparently a variation of H194 (אוּלַי);
silliness from the same as H191 (אֱוִיל);
Omar, a grandson of Esau from H559 (אָמַר); talkative;
ability, power, (figuratively) wealth probably from the same as H205 (אָוֶן) (in the sense of effort, but successful);
On, an Israelite the same as H202 (אוֹן);
On, a city of Egypt or (shortened); אֹן; of Egyptian derivation;

term: affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare H369 (אַיִן).
definition: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain; to come to naught);

term: Aven. See also H204 (אוֹן), H1007 (בֵּית אָוֶן).
definition: Aven, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele-Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel) the same as H205 (אָוֶן); idolatry;
Ono, a place in Palestine or (shortened) אֹנוֹ; prolonged from H202 (אוֹן); strong;
Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite a variation of H209 (אוֹנָן); strong;
Onan, a son of Judah a variation of H207 (אוֹנוֹ); strong;
Uphaz, a famous gold region perhaps a corruption of H211 (אוֹפִיר);
Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation;
a wheel or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve;
to press; (by implication) to be close, hurry, withdraw a primitive root;
a depository from H686 (אָצַר);

term: [idiom] break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.
definition: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically) a primitive root;

term: bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun.
definition: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.) from H215 (אוֹר);
flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light) from H215 (אוֹר);
Ur, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite the same as H217 (אוּר);
luminousness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity; also a plant (as being bright) feminine of H216 (אוֹר);
a stall by transposition for H723 (אֻרְוָה);
Uri, the name of three Israelites from H217 (אוּר); fiery;
Uriel, the name of two Israelites from H217 (אוּר) and H410 (אֵל); flame of God;
Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ; from H217 (אוּר) and H3050 (יָהּ); flame of Jah;
Urim, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high-priest's breastplate plural of H217 (אוּר); lights;
properly, to come, i.e. (implied) to assent a primitive root;
a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc. probably from H225 (אוּת) (in the sense of appearing);

term: beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.
definition: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore a demonstrative adverb;
to kindle; (by implication) to heat (Aramaic) or אֲזָה (Aramaic);
Ezbai, an Israelite probably from H231 (אֵזוֹב); hyssop-like;
firm (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation;
hyssop probably of foreign derivation;
something girt; a belt, also a band from H246 (אֲזִקִּים);
at that time probably from H227 (אָז);
a reminder; specifically remembrance-offering from H2142 (זָכַר);

term: fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).
definition: to go away, hence, to disappear a primitive root;
to depart (Aramaic) the same as H235 (אָזַל);
Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine from H235 (אָזַל); departure;

term: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See H239 (אָזַן).
definition: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from H241 (אֹזֶן);
to weigh, i.e. (figuratively) ponder a primitive root (rather identical with H238 (אָזַן) through the idea of scales as if two ears);
a spade or paddle (as having a broad end) from H238 (אָזַן);

term: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.
definition: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man) from H238 (אָזַן);
Uzzen-Sheerah, a place in Palestine from H238 (אָזַן) and H7609 (שֶׁאֱרָה); plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him);
Aznoth-Tabor, a place in Palestine from H238 (אָזַן) and H8396 (תָּבוֹר); flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it);
Ozni, an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant from H241 (אֹזֶן); having (quick) ears;
Azanjah, an Israelite from H238 (אָזַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); heard by Jah;
manacles a variation for H2131 (זִיקָה);
to belt a primitive root;
the arm a variation for H2220 (זְרוֹעַ);

term: bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).
definition: a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons) from H2224 (זָרַח) (in the sense of springing up);
an Ezrachite or descendant of Zerach patronymic from H2246 (חֹבָב);

term: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.
definition: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father)) a primitive word;
{a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H251 (אָח)
Oh! (expressive of grief or surprise) a variation for H162 (אֲהָהּ);
a fire-pot or chafing dish of uncertain derivation;
a howler or lonesome wild animal probably from H253 (אָח);
Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon once (by contraction) אֶחָב (Jeremiah 29:22); from H251 (אָח) and H1 (אָב); brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father;
Achban, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H995 (בִּין); brother (i.e. possessor) of understanding;
to unify, i.e. (figuratively) collect (one's thoughts) perhaps a primitive root;

term: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
definition: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first a numeral from H258 (אָחַד);
a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile) of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation;
Echud, the name of three Israelites from H258 (אָחַד); united;
an utterance from H2331 (חָוָה) (in the sense of H2324 (חֲוָא));
solution (of riddles) (Aramaic) corresponding to H262 (אַחְוָה);
fraternity from H251 (אָח);
Achoach, an Israelite by reduplication from H251 (אָח); brotherly;
an Achochite or descendant of Achoach patronymic from H264 (אַחֲוָה);
Achumai, an Israelite perhaps from H251 (אָח) and H4325 (מַיִם); brother (i.e. neighbour) of water;

term: after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without.
definition: the hinder part; hence (adverb) behind, backward; also (as facing north) the West or (shortened) אָחֹר ; from H299 (אֲחִירַע);
a sister (used very widely (like brother), literally and figuratively) irregular feminine of H251 (אָח);

term: [phrase] be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion).
definition: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession) a primitive root;
Achaz, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite from H270 (אָחַז); possessor;
something seized, i.e. a possession (especially of land) feminine passive participle from H270 (אָחַז);
Achzai, an Israelite from H270 (אָחַז); seizer;
Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ; from H270 (אָחַז) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has seized;
Achuzzam, an Israelite from H270 (אָחַז); seizure;
Achuzzath, a Philistine a variation of H272 (אֲחֻזָּה); possession;
Achi, the name of two Israelites from H251 (אָח); brotherly;
Echi, an Israelite probably the same as H277 (אֲחִי);
Achiam, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H517 (אֵם); brother of the mother (i.e. uncle);
an enigma (Aramaic) corresponding to H2420 (חִידָה),
Achijah, the name of nine Israelites or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ ; from H251 (אָח) and H3050 (יָהּ); brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;
Achihud, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H1935 (הוֹד); brother (i.e. possessor) of renown;
Achio, the name of three Israelites prolonged from H251 (אָח); brotherly;
Achichud, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H2330 (חוּד); brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious);
Achitub, the name of several priests from H251 (אָח) and H2898 (טוּב); brother of goodness;
Achilud, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H3205 (יָלַד); brother of one born;
Achimoth, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H4191 (מוּת); brother of death;
Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite from H251 (אָח) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); brother of (the) king;
Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite or אֲחִימָן ; from H251 (אָח) and H4480 (מִן); brother of a portion (i.e. gift);
Achimaats, the name of three Israelites from H251 (אָח) and the equivalent of H4619 (מַעַץ); brother of anger;
Achjan, an Israelite from H251 (אָח); brotherly;
Achinadab, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H5068 (נָדַב); brother of liberality;
Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses from H251 (אָח) and H5278 (נֹעַם); brother of pleasantness;
Achisamak, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H5564 (סָמַךְ); brother of support;
Achiezer, the name of two Israelites from H251 (אָח) and H5828 (עֵזֶר); brother of help;
Achikam, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H6965 (קוּם); brother of rising (i.e. high);
Achiram, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H7311 (רוּם); brother of height (i.e. high);
an Achiramite or descendant (collectively) of Achiram patronymic from H297 (אֲחִירָם);
Achira, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H7451 (רַע); brother of wrong;
Achishachar, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H7837 (שַׁחַר); brother of (the) dawn;
Achishar, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H7891 (שִׁיר); brother of (the) singer;
Achithophel, an Israelite from H251 (אָח) and H8602 (תָּפֵל); brother of folly;
Achlab, a place in Palestine from the same root as H2459 (חֶלֶב); fatness (i.e. fertile);
Achlai, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite the same as H305 (אַחֲלַי); wishful;
would that! or אַחֲלֵי; prob from H253 (אָח) and a variation of H3863 (לוּא);
a gem, probably the amethyst perhaps from H2492 (חָלַם) (and thus dream-stone);
Achmetha (i.e. Ecbatana), the summer capital of Persia of Persian derivation;
Achasbai, an Israelite of uncertain derivation;

term: continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).
definition: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate a primitive root;

term: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
definition: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses) from H309 (אָחַר);
after (Aramaic) corresponding to H310 (אַחַר);
properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc. from H309 (אָחַר);
Acher, an Israelite the same as H312 (אַחֵר);

term: after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter) most.
definition: hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western or (shortened) אַחֲרֹן; from H309 (אָחַר);
Achrach, an Israelite from H310 (אַחַר) and H251 (אָח); after (his) brother;
Acharchel, an Israelite from H310 (אַחַר) and H2426 (חֵיל); behind (the) intrenchment (i.e. safe);
other (Aramaic) from H311 (אַחַר);
last (Aramaic) or (shortened) אׇחֳרֵן; (Aramaic) from H317 (אׇחֳרִי);

term: (last, latter) end (time), hinder (utter) -most, length, posterity, remnant, residue, reward.
definition: the last or end, hence, the future; also posterity from H310 (אַחַר);
later (Aramaic) from H311 (אַחַר); the same as H319 (אַחֲרִית);
other (Aramaic) from H311 (אַחַר); the same as H317 (אׇחֳרִי);
backwards prolonged from H268 (אָחוֹר);
a satrap or governorof amain province (of Persia) of Persian derivation;
{a satrap or governorof amain province (of Persia)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H323 (אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפַּן)
Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king or (shortened) אַחַשְׁרֹשׁ (Esther 10:1); of Persian origin;
an achastarite (i.e. courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite probably of Persian derivation;
a mule of Persian origin;
(as a noun) a necromancer (from their soft incantations), (as an adverb) gently from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly;
a thorn-tree (especially the buckthorn) from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast;
properly, twisted (yarn), i.e. tapestry from an unused root (probably meaning to bind);
to close (the lips or ears); by analology to contract (a window by bevelled jambs) a primitive root;
to close up a primitive root;
Ater, the name of three Israelites from H332 (אָטַר); maimed;
shut up, i.e. impeded (as to the use of the right hand) from H332 (אָטַר);

term: how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).
definition: where? hence how? perhaps from H370 (אַיִן);
not probably identical with H335 (אַי) (through the idea of a query);
alas! short from H188 (אוֹי);
a howler (used only in the plural), i.e. any solitary wild creature probably identical with H337 (אִי) (through the idea of a doleful sound);
properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island from H183 (אָוָה);
to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile a primitive root;
hating; an adversary or (fully) אוֹיֵב; active participle of H340 (אָיַב);
hostility from H340 (אָיַב);
oppression; by implication misfortune, ruin from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of bending down);
the screamer, i.e. a hawk perhaps from H337 (אִי);
Ajah, the name of two Israelites the same as H344 (אַיָּה);
where? prolonged from H335 (אַי);
Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience from H340 (אָיַב); hated (i.e. persecuted);
Izebel, the wife of king Ahab from H336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and H2083 (זְבֻל);
how? or how!; also where also אֵיכָה ; and אֵיכָכָה ; prolonged from H335 (אַי);
Ikabod, a son of Phineas from H336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and H3519 (כָּבוֹד); (there is) no glory, i.e. inglorious;
where probably a variation for H349 (אֵיךְ), but not as an interogative;

term: mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.
definition: properly, strength; hence, anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree from the same as H193 (אוּל);
strength a variation of H352 (אַיִל);
a stag or male deer an intensive form of H352 (אַיִל) (in the sense of ram);
a doe or female deer feminine of H354 (אַיָּל);
Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites or (shortened) אֵלוֹן ; or אֵילֹן ; from H352 (אַיִל); oak-grove;
Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine from H354 (אַיָּל); deer-field;
Elon of Beth-chanan, a place in Palestine from H356 (אֵילוֹן), H1004 (בַּיִת), and H2603 (חָנַן); oak-grove of (the) house of favor;
Eloth or Elath, a place on the Red Sea or אֵילַת ; from H352 (אַיִל); trees or a grove (i.e. palms);
power; by implication, protection feminine of H353 (אֱיָל);
a pillar-space (or colonnade), i.e. a pale (or portico) or (shortened) אֵלָם ; or (feminine) אֵלַמָּה ; probably from H352 (אַיִל);
Elim, a place in the Desert plural of H352 (אַיִל); palm-trees;
a tree (Aramaic) corresponding to H356 (אֵילוֹן);
El-Paran, a portion of the district of Paran from H352 (אַיִל) and H6290 (פָּארָן); oak of Paran;
a doe the same as H355 (אַיָּלָה);
frightful from an unused root (meaning to frighten);

term: dread, fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.
definition: fright; concrete, an idol (as a bugbear) or (shortened) אֵמָה; from the same as H366 (אָיֹם);
Emim, an early Canaanitish (or Maobitish) tribe plural of H367 (אֵימָה); terrors;

term: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
definition: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist;
where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence) probably identical with H369 (אַיִן) in the sense of query (compare H336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי)
is it not? apparently a shortened form of H369 (אַיִן); but (like H370 (אַיִן)) an interrogative;
Iezer, an Israelite from H336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and H5828 (עֵזֶר); helpless;
an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer patronymic from H372 (אִיעֶזֵר);
an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general or (shortened) אֵפָה ; of Egyptian derivation;
what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how? from H335 (אַי) and H6311 (פֹּה);

term: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
definition: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation) contracted for H582 (אֱנוֹשׁ) (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant);
to be a man, i.e. act in amanly way denominative from H376 (אִישׁ);
Ish-Bosheth, a son of King Saul from H376 (אִישׁ) and H1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); man of shame;
Ishod, an Israelite from H376 (אִישׁ) and H1935 (הוֹד); man of renown;
the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night) diminutive from H376 (אִישׁ);

Ishchail (or Ish-chai), an Israelite from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2428 (חַיִל); man of might; by defective transcription (2 Samuel 23:20) אִישׁ־חַיxlit ʼÎsh-Chay corrected to ʼÎysh-Chay; as if from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2416 (חַי); living man;
Ish-Tob, a place in Palestine from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2897 (טוֹב); man of Tob;

term: art thou, can, do ye, have, it be, there is (are), [idiom] we will not.
definition: properly, entity; used only as aparticle of affirmation, there is (Aramaic) corresponding to H3426 (יֵשׁ);
Ithiel, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolical person perhaps from H837 (אֹשֶׁר) and H410 (אֵל); God has arrived;

Allon, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine the same as H437 (אַלּוֹן);

alas! by reduplication from H421 (אָלָה);

a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow from H502 (אָלַף);

established, i.e. (figuratively) trusty; also (abstractly) trustworthiness from H539 (אָמַן);
