term: (call, be) bless(-ed, happy), go, guide, lead, relieve.
definition: to be straight (used in the widest sense, especially to be level, right, happy); figuratively, to go forward, be honest, proper or אָשֵׁר; a primitive root;

term: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
definition: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc. a primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number);
happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy! from H833 (אָשַׁר);
happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine from H833 (אָשַׁר),
happiness from H833 (אָשַׁר);
a step or אַשֻּׁר; from H833 (אָשַׁר) in the sense of going;
the cedar tree or some other light elastic wood contracted for H8391 (תְּאַשּׁוּר);
Asarel, an Israelite by orthographical variation from H833 (אָשַׁר) and H410 (אֵל); right of God;
Asarelah, an Israelite from the same as H840 (אֲשַׂרְאֵל); right toward God;
Asherah (or Astarte) a Phoenician goddess; also an image of the same or אֲשֵׁירָה; from H833 (אָשַׁר); happy;
an Asherite (collectively) or descendant of Asher patronymic from H836 (אָשֵׁר);
Asriel, the name of two Israelites an orthographical variation for H840 (אֲשַׂרְאֵל);
an Asrielite (collectively) or descendant of Asriel patronymic from H844 (אַשְׂרִיאֵל);
a wall (from its uprightness) (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H833 (אָשַׁר);
Eshtaol, a place in Palestine or אֶשְׁתָּאוֹל; probably from H7592 (שָׁאַל); intreaty;
an Eshtaolite (collectively) or inhabitant of Eshtaol patrial from H847 (אֶשְׁתָּאֹל);
rebellion (Aramaic) from H7712 (שְׁדַר) (in a bad sense);
Eshton, an Israelite probably from the same as H7764 (שׁוּנִי); restful;
Eshtemoa or Eshtemoh, a place in Palestine or אֶשְׁתְּמוֹעַ; or אֶשְׁתְּמֹה; from H8085 (שָׁמַע) (in the sense of obedience);
a portent (Aramaic) corresponding to H226 (אוֹת);
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely) apparent contracted from H226 (אוֹת) in the demonstrative sense of entity;

term: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.
definition: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc. probably from H579 (אָנָה);
a hoe or other digging implement of uncertain derivation;
Ethbaal, a Phoenician king from H854 (אֵת) and H1168 (בַּעַל); with Baal;
to arrive or אָתָא; a primitive root (collateral to H225 (אוּת) contraction);
{to arrive} (Aramaic) or אָתָא; (Aramaic), corresponding to H857 (אָתָה)

thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you or (shortened); אַתָּ; or אַת; feminine (irregular) sometimes אַתִּי; plural masculine אַתֶּם; feminine אַתֶּן; or אַתֵּנָהlemma אתֵּנָה missing vowel, corrected to אַתֵּנָה; or אַתֵּנָּה; a primitive pronoun of the second person;
a female donkey (from its docility) probably from the same as H386 (אֵיתָן) (in the sense of patience);
probably a fire-place, i.e. furnace (Aramaic) probably from the corresponding to H784 (אֵשׁ);
a ledge or offset in abuilding or אַתִּיק; from H5423 (נָתַק) in the sense of decreasing;
Ittai or Ithai, the name of a Gittite and of an Israelite or אִיתַי; from H854 (אֵת); near;
Etham, a place in the Desert of Egyptian derivation;

term: [phrase] before (that) time, [phrase] heretofore, of late (old), [phrase] times past, yester(day).
definition: heretofore; definitely yesterday or אִתְמוֹל; or אֶתְמוּל; probably from H853 (אֵת) or H854 (אֵת) and H4136 (מוּל);
a present (as the price of harlotry) from H8566 (תָּנָה);
Ethni, an Israelite perhaps from H866 (אֶתְנָה); munificence;
a gift (as the price of harlotry or idolatry) the same as H866 (אֶתְנָה);
Ethnan, an Israelite the same as H868 (אֶתְנַן) in the sense of H867 (אֶתְנִי);
a place; (adverb) after (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H871 (אֲתָרִים);
Atharim, a place near Palestine plural from an unused root (probably meaning to step); places;
an entrance to a building from H935 (בּוֹא);
wicked (Aramaic) from H888 (בְּאֵשׁ);
to dig; by analogy, to engrave; figuratively, to explain a primitive root;
a pit; especially a well from H874 (בָּאַר);
Beer, a place in the Desert, also one in Palestine the same as H875 (בְּאֵר);
a cistern from H874 (בָּאַר);
Beera, an Israelite from H875 (בְּאֵר); a well;
Beer-Elim, a place in the Desert from H875 (בְּאֵר) and the plural of H410 (אֵל); well of heroes;
Beerah, an Israelite the same as H878 (בְּאֵרָא);
Beeroth, a place in Palestine feminine plural of H875 (בְּאֵר); wells;
Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite from H875 (בְּאֵר); fountained;
Beer-Lachai-Roi, a place in the Desert from H875 (בְּאֵר) and H2416 (חַי) (with prefix) and H7203 (רֹאֶה); well of a living (One) my Seer;
Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine from H875 (בְּאֵר) and H7651 (שֶׁבַע) (in the sense of H7650 (שָׁבַע)); well of an oath;

term: Beeroth of the children of Jaakan.
definition: Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert from the feminine plural of H875 (בְּאֵר), and the plural contraction of H1121 (בֵּן), and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); wells of (the) sons of Jaakan;
a Beerothite or inhabitant of Beeroth patrial from H881 (בְּאֵרוֹת);

term: (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly.
definition: to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally a primitive root;
{to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally} (Aramaic) corresponding to H887 (בָּאַשׁ)
a stench from H877 (בֹּאר);
stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant feminine of H889 (בְּאֹשׁ);
poison-berries plural of H889 (בְּאֹשׁ);
something hollowed (as a gate), i.e. pupil of the eye feminine active participle of an unused root meaning to hollow out;
Bebai, an Israelite probably of foreign origin;
Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire from H1101 (בָּלַל); confusion;
{Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire} (Aramaic) corresponding to H894 (בָּבֶל)
a Babylonian (Aramaic) patrial from H895 (בַּבֶל);
food a Persian word;

term: deal deceitfully (treacherously, unfaithfully), offend, transgress(-or), (depart), treacherous (dealer, -ly, man), unfaithful(-ly, man), [idiom] very.
definition: to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage a primitive root;

term: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.
definition: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage from H898 (בָּגַד);
treacheries feminine plural active participle of H898 (בָּגַד);
treacherous from H898 (בָּגַד);
Bigvai, an Israelite probably of foreign origin;
Bigtha, a eunuch of Xerxes of Persian derivation;
Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to H903 (בִּגְתָא);

term: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.
definition: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides from H909 (בָּדַד);
flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment perhaps from H909 (בָּדַד) (in the sense of divided fibres);
a brag or lie; also a liar from H908 (בָּדָא);
(figuratively) to invent a primitive root;
to divide, i.e. (reflex.) be solitary a primitive root;
separate; adverb, separately from H909 (בָּדַד);
Bedad, an Edomite from H909 (בָּדַד); separation;
Bedejah, an Israelite probably a shortened form H5662 (עֹבַדְיָה); servant of Jehovah;
alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin from H914 (בָּדַל);

term: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.
definition: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.) a primitive root;
a part from H914 (בָּדַל);
something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl probably from H914 (בָּדַל);
Bedan, the name of two Israelites probably shortened for H5658 (עַבְדוֹן); servile;
to mend a breach a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from H919 (בֶּדֶק);
a gap or leak (in a building or a ship) from H918 (בָּדַק);
Bidkar, an Israelite probably from H1856 (דָּקַר) with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin;
to scatter (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition) to H6504 (פָּרַד);
a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin from an unused root (meaning to be empty);
white marble or perhaps alabaster from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten);
a hurry; only adverb, hastily (Aramaic) from H927 (בְּהַל);
shining from an unused root (meaning to be bright);

term: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.
definition: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously a primitive root;
to terrify, hasten (Aramaic) corresponding to H926 (בָּהַל);
panic, destruction from H926 (בָּהַל);
properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective) from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute);
a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse in form a plural or H929 (בְּהֵמָה), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation;
the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick;
thumb, Bohan, an Israelite an orthographical variation of H931 (בֹּהֶן);
white scurf from an unused root meaning to be pale;
a whitish spot on the skin feminine active participle of the same as H925 (בָּהִיר);

term: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
definition: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications) a primitive root;
to disrespect a primitive root;
disrespect from H936 (בּוּז);
Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite the same as H937 (בּוּז);
something scorned; an object of contempt feminine passive participle of H936 (בּוּז);
a Buzite or descendant of Buz patronymic from H938 (בּוּז);
Buzi, an Israelite the same as H940 (בּוּזִי);
Bavvai, an Israelite probably of Persian origin;
to involve (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
produce (of the earth, etc.) for H2981 (יְבוּל);
Bul, the eighth Hebrew month the same as H944 (בּוּל) (in the sense of rain);
Bunah, an Israelite from H995 (בִּין); discretion;
to trample (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
probably cotton (of some sort) from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white;
Botsets, a rock near Michmash from the same as H948 (בּוּץ); shining;
emptiness (as adjective) feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow);
a cattle-tender properly, active participle from H1239 (בָּקַר) as denominative from H1241 (בָּקָר);
to bore, i.e. (figuratively) examine a primitive root;
a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison) from H952 (בּוּר) (in the sense of H877 (בֹּאר));

term: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.
definition: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed a primitive root;
shame feminine participle passive of H954 (בּוּשׁ);
to lodge over night (Aramaic) apparent denominative from H1005 (בַּיִת);
plunder from H962 (בָּזַז);
probably to cleave a primitive root;

term: despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), [phrase] think to scorn, vile person.
definition: to disesteem a primitive root;
scorned from H959 (בָּזָה);
booty feminine of H957 (בַּז);

term: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.
definition: to plunder a primitive root;
disesteem from H959 (בָּזָה)
Bizjothjah, a place in Palestine from H959 (בָּזָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); contempts of Jah;
a flash of lightning from an unused root meaning to lighten;
Bezek, a place in Palestine from H965 (בָּזָק); lightning;
to disperse a primitive root;
Biztha, a eunuch of Xerxes of Persian origin;
an assayer or metals from H974 (בָּחַן);
properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective) or בָּחֻר; participle passive of H977 (בָּחַר);
a watch-tower of besiegers another form of H975 (בַּחַן);
select from H977 (בָּחַר);

term: abhor, get hastily (from the margin for H926 (בָּהַל)).
definition: to loath a primitive root;
to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate a primitive root;
a watch-tower from H974 (בָּחַן) (in the sense of keeping a look-out);
trial from H974 (בָּחַן);

term: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.
definition: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select a primitive root;
a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim patrial from H980 (בַּחֻרִים) (by transposition);
youth (collectively and abstractly) or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים;
Bachurim, a place in Palestine or בַּחוּרִים; masculine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); young men;
to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily or בָּטָה; a primitive root;

term: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.
definition: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure a primitive root; properly, to hide for refuge (but not so precipitately as H2620 (חָסָה));

term: assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.
definition: properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely from H982 (בָּטַח);
Betach, a place in Syria the same as H983 (בֶּטַח);
trust feminine of H984 (בֶּטַח);
trust from H982 (בָּטַח);
security feminine plural from H982 (בָּטַח);
to desist from labor a primitive root;
to stop (Aramaic) corresponding to H988 (בָּטֵל);

term: belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.
definition: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow;
Beten. a place in Palestine the same as H990 (בֶּטֶן);
(only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form) from H990 (בֶּטֶן);
Betonim, a place in Palestine probably plural from H992 (בֹּטֶן); hollows;
oh that!; with leave, or if it please perhaps from H1158 (בָּעָה) (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord');

term: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).
definition: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand a primitive root;

term: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
definition: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from H995 (בִּין); a distinction; but used only as a preposition,
{between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or} (Aramaic) corresponding to H996 (בֵּין)
understanding from H995 (בִּין);
{understanding} (Aramaic) corresponding to H998 (בִּינָה)
an egg (from its whiteness) from the same as H948 (בּוּץ);
a palace (Aramaic) corresponding to H1002 (בִּירָה);
a castle or palace of foreign origin;
a fortress from H1002 (בִּירָה);

term: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
definition: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.) probably from H1129 (בָּנָה) abbreviated;
{a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1004 (בַּיִת)
Bajith, a place in Palestine the same as H1004 (בַּיִת);
Beth-Aven, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H205 (אָוֶן); house of vanity;
Beth-El, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H410 (אֵל); house of God;
Beth-Arbel, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H695 (אֶרֶב) and H410 (אֵל); house of God's ambush;

term: Beth-baal-meon. Compare H1186 (בַּעַל מְעוֹן) and H1194 (בְּעֹן).
definition: Beth-Baal-Meon, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal);
Beth-Biri, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1254 (בָּרָא); house of a creative one;
Beth-Barah, a place in Palestine probably from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5679 (עֲבָרָה); house of (the) ford;
Beth-Gader, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1447 (גָּדֵר); house of (the) wall;
Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the passive participle of H1576 (גְּמוּל); house of (the) weaned;
Beth-Diblathajim, a place East of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the dual of H1690 (דְּבֵלָה); house of (the) two figcakes;
Beth-Dagon, the name of two places in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1712 (דָּגוֹן); house of Dagon;
a Beth-elite, or inhabitant of Bethel patrial from H1008 (בֵּית־אֵל) with the article interposed;
Beth-ha-Etsel, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H681 (אֵצֶל) with the article interposed; house of the side;
Beth-hag-Gilgal, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1537 (גִּלְגָּל) with the article interposed; house of Gilgal (or rolling);
Beth-ha-Jeshimoth, a town East of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H3451 (יְשִׁימַה) with the article interposed; house of the deserts;
Beth-hak-Kerem, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3754 (כֶּרֶם) with the article interposed; house of the vineyard;
a Beth-lechemite, or native of Bethlechem patrial from H1035 (בֵּית לֶחֶם) with the article inserted;
Beth-ham-Merchak, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4801 (מֶרְחָק) with the article interposed; house of the breadth;

Beth-ham-Markaboth or Beth-Markaboth, a place in Palestine or (shortened) בֵּית מַרְכָּבוֹת; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H4818 (מֶרְכָּבָה) (with or without the article interposed); place of (the) chariots;
Beth-ha-Emek, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6010 (עֵמֶק) with the article interposed; house of the valley;
Beth-ha-Arabah, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6160 (עֲרָבָה) with the article interposed; house of the Desert;
Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7311 (רוּם) with the article interposed; house of the height;
Beth-ha-Ram, a place East of the Jordan probably for H1027 (בֵּית הָרָם);
Beth-hash-Shittah, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7848 (שִׁטָּה) with the article interposed; house of the acacia;
a Beth-shimshite, or inhabitant of Bethshemesh patrial from H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ) with the article inserted;
Beth-Choglah, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the same as H2295 (חׇגְלָה); house of a partridge;
Beth-Choron, the name of two adjoining places in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H2356 (חוֹר); house of hollowness;
Beth-Car, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3733 (כַּר); house of pasture;
Beth-Lebaoth, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the plural of H3833 (לָבִיא); house of lionesses;
Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3899 (לֶחֶם); house of bread;
Beth-le-Aphrah, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of H6083 (עָפָר) (with preposition interposed); house to (i.e. of) dust;
Beth-Millo, the name of two citadels or בֵּית מִלֹּא; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4407 (מִלּוֹא); house of (the) rampart;
Beth-Maakah, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); house of Maakah;
Beth-Nimrah, a place east of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of H5246 (נָמֵר); house of (the) leopard;
Beth-Eden, a place in Syria from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5730 (עֵדֶן); house of pleasure;
house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5820 (עַזְמָוֶת);
Beth-Anoth, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a plural from H6030 (עָנָה); house of replies;
Beth-Anath, a place in Palestine an orthographical variation for H1042 (בֵּית עֲנוֹת);
Beth-Eked, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative of H6123 (עָקַד); house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing);

term: house of Ashtaroth. Compare H1203 (בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָה), H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת).
definition: Beth-Ashtaroth, a place in Palestine ; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת); house of Ashtoreths;
Beth-Palet, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6412 (פָּלִיט); house of escape;
Beth-Peor, a place East of the Jordan from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); house of Peor;
Beth-Patstsets, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative from H6327 (פּוּץ); house of dispersion;
Beth-Tsur, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6697 (צוּר); house of (the) rock;
Beth-Rechob, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7339 (רְחֹב); house of (the) street;
Beth-Rapha, an Israelite from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7497 (רָפָא); house of (the) giant;
Beth-Shean or Beth-Shan, a place in Palestine or בֵּית שָׁן; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7599 (שָׁאַן); house of ease;
Beth-Shemesh, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); house of (the) sun;
Beth-Tappuach, a place in Palestine from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); house of (the) apple;
a palace (i.e. large house) probably from H1004 (בַּיִת);
Baca, a valley in Palestine from H1058 (בָּכָה), weeping;
the weeping tree (some gum-distilling tree, perhaps the balsam) the same as H1056 (בָּכָא);

term: [idiom] at all, bewail, complain, make lamentation, [idiom] more, mourn, [idiom] sore, [idiom] with tears, weep.
definition: to weep; generally to bemoan a primitive root;
a weeping from H1058 (בָּכָה);
firstborn; hence, chief from H1069 (בָּכַר);
the first-fruits of the crop from H1069 (בָּכַר);
the firstling of man or beast; abstractly primogeniture or (short) בְּכֹרָה; feminine of H1060 (בְּכוֹר);
the early fig feminine of H1061 (בִּכּוּר);
Bekorath, an Israelite feminine of H1062 (בְּכוֹרָה); primogeniture;
a weeping; by analogy, a dripping from H1058 (בָּכָה);
Bo-kim, a place in Palestine plural active participle of H1058 (בָּכָה); (with the article) the weepers;
the eldest daughter feminine from H1069 (בָּכַר);
a weeping from H1058 (בָּכָה);

term: make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).
definition: to give the birthright a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from H1061 (בִּכּוּר))
a young camel from H1069 (בָּכַר) (in the sense of youth);
Beker, the name of two Israelites the same as H1070 (בֶּכֶר);
a young she-camel feminine of H1070 (בֶּכֶר);
a first-ripe fig by orthographical variation for H1063 (בִּכּוּרָה);
Bokeru, an Israelite from H1069 (בָּכַר); first-born;
Bikri, an Israelite from H1069 (בָּכַר); youth-ful;
a Bakrite (collectively) or descendants of Beker patronymically from H1071 (בֶכֶר);

term: lest, neither, no, none (that...), not (any), nothing.
definition: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest from H1086 (בָּלָה);
Bel, the Baal of the Babylonians by contraction for H1168 (בַּעַל);
properly, anxiety, i.e. (by implication) the heart (as its seat) (Aramaic) from H1080 (בְּלָא);
to afflict (Aramaic) corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה) (but used only in a mental sense);
Baladan, the name of a Babylonian prince from H1078 (בֵּל) and H113 (אָדוֹן) (contracted); Bel (is his) lord;
to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction) a primitive root;
Bilgah, the name of two Israelites from H1082 (בָּלַג); desistance;
Bilgai, an Israelite from H1082 (בָּלַג); desistant;
Bildad, one of Job's friends of uncertain derivation;

term: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.
definition: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend) a primitive root;
worn out from H1086 (בָּלָה);
Balah, a place in Palestine feminine of H1087 (בָּלֶה); failure;
to palpitate; hence, (causatively) to terrify a primitive root (rather by transposition for H926 (בָּהַל));
Bilhah, the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine from H1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid;
alarm; hence, destruction from H1089 (בָּלַהּ);
Bilhan, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite from H1089 (בָּלַהּ); timid;
excise (on articles consumed) (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה);
(only in plural construction) rags or (fully) בְּלוֹי; from H1086 (בָּלָה);
Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel of foreign derivation;
{Belteshatstsar, the Babylonian name of Daniel} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר)

term: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.
definition: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc. from H1086 (בָּלָה);
mixed, i.e. (specifically) feed (for cattle) from H1101 (בָּלַל);
(as indefinitely) nothing whatever from H1097 (בְּלִי) and H4100 (מָה);
without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness from H1097 (בְּלִי) and H3276 (יַעַל);(often in connection with H376 (אִישׁ), H802 (אִשָּׁה), H1121 (בֵּן), etc.)

term: anoint, confound, [idiom] fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.
definition: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder a primitive root; (also  denominatively from H1098 (בְּלִיל)) to fodder
to muzzle a primitive root;
to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them) a primitive root;

term: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).
definition: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy a primitive root;

term: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.
definition: a gulp; figuratively, destruction from H1104 (בָּלַע);
Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites the same as H1105 (בֶּלַע);
except, without, besides or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from H1077 (בַּל) and H5703 (עַד), not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb)
a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela patronymically from H1106 (בֶּלַע);
Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine probably from H1077 (בַּל) and H5971 (עַם); not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner;
to annihilate a primitive root;
Balak, a Moabitish king from H1110 (בָּלַק); waster;
Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare H1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר));
{Belshatstsar, a Babylonian king} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1112 (בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר)
Bilshan, an Israelite of uncertain derivation;

term: because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.
definition: properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc. constructive feminine of H1086 (בָּלָה) (equivalent to H1097 (בְּלִי));
an elevation from an unused root (meaning to be high);
Bamah, a place in Palestine the same as H1116 (בָּמָה);
Bimhal, an Israelite probably from H4107 (מָהַל) with prepositional prefix; with pruning;
in, with, by, etc. prolongation for prepositional prefix;
Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and H1168 (בַּעַל); heights of Baal;

term: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
definition: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.) from H1129 (בָּנָה);
Ben, an Israelite the same as H1121 (בֵּן);
{a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1121 (בֵּן)
to build (Aramaic) or בְּנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1129 (בָּנָה);
Ben-Abinadab, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H40 (אֲבִימֶלֶךְ); (the) son of Abinadab;
Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow;
Ben-Geber, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero;
Ben-Deker, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and a derivative of H1856 (דָּקַר); son of piercing (or of a lance);

term: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.
definition: to build (literally and figuratively) a primitive root;
Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad;
Binnui, an Israelite from H1129 (בָּנָה); built up;
Ben-Zocheth, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth;
Ben-Chur, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2354 (חוּר); son of Chur;
Ben-Chail, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might;
Ben-Chanan, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan;
Ben-Chesed, an Israelite from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness;
Bani, the name of five Israelites from H1129 (בָּנָה); built;
Bunni or Buni, an Israelite or (fuller) בּוּנִי; from H1129 (בָּנָה); built;
sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק);
a structure feminine from H1129 (בָּנָה);
Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built;
Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;
a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies dual of H996 (בֵּין);
Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory from H1121 (בֵּן) and H3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand;

a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144 (בִּנְיָמִין);
an edifice from H1129 (בָּנָה);
{an edifice} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1146 (בִּנְיָן)
Beninu, an Israelite probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son;
to be enraged (Aramaic) of uncertain affinity;
Bina or Binah, an Israelite or בִּנְעָה; of uncertain derivation;
Ben-Ammi, a son of Lot from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people;
Besodejah, an Israelite from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah;
Besai, one of the Nethinim from H947 (בּוּס); domineering;
an immature grape from an unused root meaning to be sour;
{an immature grape} from the same as H1154 (בֶּסֶר)

term: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.
definition: to seek or ask (Aramaic) or בְּעָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1158 (בָּעָה);

term: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.
definition: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc. from H5704 (עַד) with prepositional prefix;

term: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.
definition: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask a primitive root;
a request (Aramaic) from H1156 (בְּעָא);
Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;
alarms masculine plural from H1204 (בָּעַת);
Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
to trample down, i.e. (figuratively) despise a primitive root;
a prayer from H1158 (בָּעָה);
cattle from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating);

term: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).
definition: to be master; hence, to marry a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)

term: [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of.
definition: a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense) from H1166 (בָּעַל);
Baal, a Phoenician deity the same as H1167 (בַּעַל);
{a master; hence, a husband,} (Aramaic) corresponding to H1167 (בַּעַל)
Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant;
Baal-Gad, a place in Syria from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune;
a mistress feminine of H1167 (בַּעַל);
Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine the same as H1172 (בַּעֲלָה);
Baal-Hamon, a place in Palestine from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude;

term: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from H5927 (עָלָה) with prepositional prefix).
definition: Bealoth, a place in Palestine plural of H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistresses;
Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly;
Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace;
Baal-Chatsor, a place in Palestine from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village;
Baal-Chermon, a place in Palestine from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon;
Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master;
Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights;
Beeljada, an Israelite from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known;
Bealjah, an Israelite from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master;
Baale-Jehudah, a place in Palestine from the plural of H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah;
Baalis, an Ammonitish king probably from a derivative of H5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation;
Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן));
Baal-Peor, a Moabitish deity from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor;
Baal-Peratsim, a place in Palestine from H1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches;
Baal-Tsephon, a place in Eqypt from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6828 (צָפוֹן) (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter;
Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H8031 (שָׁלִשָׁה);
Baalath, a place in Palestine a modification of H1172 (בַּעֲלָה); mistressship;
Baalath-Beer, a place in Palestine from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well;
Baal-Tamar, a place in Palestine from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree;
Beon, a place East of the Jordan probably a contraction of H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן);
Banana, the name of four Israelite the same as H1196 (בַּעֲנָה);
Baanah, the name of four Israelites from a derivative of H6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction

term: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.
definition: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating);  to be(-come) brutish a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198 (בַּעַר)
properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid from H1197 (בָּעַר);
Baara, an Israelitish woman from H1198 (בַּעַר); brutish;
a burning from H1197 (בָּעַר);
Basha, a king of Israel from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness;
Baasejah, an Israelite from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah;
Beeshterah, a place East of the Jordan from H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;
to fear a primitive root;
fear from H1204 (בָּעַת);
mud (as whitish clay) probably the same as H948 (בּוּץ);
a swamp intensive from H1206 (בֹץ);
inaccessible, i.e. lofty from H1219 (בָּצַר);
Betsai, the name of two Israelites perhaps the same as H1153 (בְּסַי);
clipped, i.e. the grape crop from H1219 (בָּצַר);
an onion from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;
Betsalel, the name of two Israelites probably from H6738 (צֵל) and H410 (אֵל) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God;

to tax a fifth a denominative from H2568 (חָמֵשׁ);
five masculine חֲמִשָּׁה; a primitive numeral;
a fifth tax from H2567 (חָמַשׁ);
the abdomen (as obese) from an unused root probably meaning, to be stout;
staunch, i.e. able-bodied soldiers passive participle of the same as H2570 (חֹמֶשׁ);
fifty multiple of H2568 (חָמֵשׁ);
a skin bottle (as tied up) from the same as H2346 (חוֹמָה);
Chamath, a place in Syria from the same as H2346 (חוֹמָה); walled;
Chammath, a place in Palestine a variation for the first part of H2576 (חַמֹּת דֹּאר); hot springs;
Chammath-Dor, a place in Palestine from the plural of H2535 (חַמָּה) and H1756 (דּוֹר); hot springs of Dor;
a Chamathite or native of Chamath patrial from H2574 (חֲמָת);
Chamath-Tsobah from H2574 (חֲמָת) and H6678 (צוֹבָא); Chamath of Tsobah; probably the same as H2574 (חֲמָת)
Chamath-Rabbah from H2574 (חֲמָת) and H7237 (רַבָּה); Chamath of Rabbah; probably the same as H2574 (חֲמָת).
graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty) from H2603 (חָנַן);
Chen, a figurative name for an Israelite the same as H2580 (חֵן); grace;
Chenadad, an Israelite probably from H2580 (חֵן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); favor of Hadad;

term: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.
definition: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege) a primitive root (compare H2603 (חָנַן));
Channah, an Israelitess from H2603 (חָנַן); favored;
Chanok, an antediluvian patriach from H2596 (חָנַךְ); initiated;
Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites from H2603 (חָנַן); favored;
gracious from H2603 (חָנַן);
properly, a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication, a prison from H2583 (חָנָה);
supplication from H2603 (חָנַן) (in the sense of prayer);
to spice; by implication, to embalm; also to ripen a primitive root;
wheat (Aramaic) corresponding to H2406 (חִטָּה);
Channiel, the name of two Israelites from H2603 (חָנַן) and H410 (אֵל); favor of God;
initiated; i.e. practiced from H2596 (חָנַךְ);
graciousness from H2603 (חָנַן);
a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent) from H2583 (חָנָה);
properly, to narrow; figuratively, to initiate or discipline a primitive root; (compare H2614 (חָנַק))
consecration (Aramaic) corresponding to H2598 (חֲנֻכָּה);
initiation, i.e. consecration from H2596 (חָנַךְ);
a Chanokite (collectively) or descendants of Chanok patronymically from H2585 (חֲנוֹךְ);

term: without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought, in vain.
definition: gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage from H2580 (חֵן);
Chanamel, an Israelite probably by orthographical variation for H2606 (חֲנַנְאֵל);
perhaps the aphis or plantlouse of uncertain derivation;

term: beseech, [idiom] fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, [idiom] very.
definition: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition) a primitive root (compare H2583 (חָנָה));
to favor or (causatively) to entreat (Aramaic) corresponding to H2603 (חָנַן);
Chanan, the name of seven Israelites from H2603 (חָנַן); favor;
Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named from H2603 (חָנַן) and H410 (אֵל); God has favored;
Chanani, the name of six Israelites from H2603 (חָנַן); gracious;
Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites or חֲנַנְיָהוּ; from H2603 (חָנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored;
Chanes, a place in Egypt of Egyptian derivation;
to soil, especially in a moral sense a primitive root;
soiled (i.e. with sin), impious from H2610 (חָנֵף);
moral filth, i.e. wickedness from H2610 (חָנֵף);
impiety feminine from H2610 (חָנֵף);
to be narrow; by implication, to throttle, or (reflex.) to choke oneself to death (by a rope) a primitive root (compare H2596 (חָנַךְ));
Channathon, a place in Palestine probably from H2603 (חָנַן); favored;

term: shew self merciful, put to shame.
definition: properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only  in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove a primitive root; (compare H2603 (חָנַן)); (compare H1288 (בָרַךְ))

term: favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.
definition: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty from H2616 (חָסַד);
Chesed, an Israelite the same as H2617 (חֵסֵד); favor;
Chasadjah, an Israelite from H2617 (חֵסֵד) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored;
to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in a primitive root; (compare H982 (בָּטַח))
Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine from H2620 (חָסָה); hopeful;
confidence from H2620 (חָסָה);

term: godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un-) godly.
definition: properly, kind, i.e. (religiously) pious (a saint) from H2616 (חָסַד);
the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork feminine of H2623 (חָסִיד);
the ravager, i.e. a locust from H2628 (חָסַל);
properly, firm, i.e. (by implication) mighty from H2630 (חָסַן);
deficient (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2637 (חָסֵר);
to eat off a primitive root;
to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose a primitive root;
properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard a primitive root;
to hold in occupancy (Aramaic) corresponding to H2630 (חָסַן);
strength (Aramaic) from H2631 (חֲסַן);
wealth from H2630 (חָסַן);
powerful from H2630 (חָסַן);
a clod (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H2636 (חַסְפַּס);
a shred or scale reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel;

term: be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.
definition: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen a primitive root;

term: destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.
definition: lacking; hence, without from H2637 (חָסֵר);
lack; hence, destitution from H2637 (חָסֵר);
poverty from H2637 (חָסֵר);
Chasrah, an Israelite from H2637 (חָסֵר); want
deficiency from H2637 (חָסֵר);
pure from H2653 (חׇפַף) (in the moral sense of covered from soil);
properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly an orthographical variation of H2645 (חָפָה);
to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect a primitive root (compare H2644 (חָפָא), H2653 (חׇפַף));
a canopy from H2645 (חָפָה);
Chuppah, an Israelite the same as H2646 (חֻפָּה);
properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear a primitive root;
hasty flight from H2468 (חֻלְדָּה);
Chuppim, an Israelite plural of H2646 (חֻפָּה) (compare H2349 (חוּפָם));
a fist (only in the dual) from an unused root of uncertain signification;
Chophni, an Israelite from H2651 (חֹפֶן); perhaps pugilist;
to cover (in protection) a primitive root (compare H2645 (חָפָה), H3182 (יָחֵף));

term: [idiom] any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.
definition: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire a primitive root;

term: delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.
definition: pleased with from H2654 (חָפֵץ);

term: acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.
definition: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind) from H2654 (חָפֵץ);
Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine from H2656 (חֵפֶץ) with suffixes; my delight (is) in her;
properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore a primitive root;

term: be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.
definition: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H2658 (חָפַר) through the idea of detection);
Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites from H2658 (חָפַר) or H2659 (חָפֵר); a pit of shame;

a burrower, i.e. probably a rat from H2658 (חָפַר); a hole; only in connection with H6512 (פֵּרָה), which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus חַפַרְפֵּרָה; by reduplication from H2658 (חָפַר);
a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher patronymically from H2660 (חֵפֶר);
Chapharajim, a place in Palestine dual of H2660 (חֵפֶר); double pit;

term: change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).
definition: to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask a primitive root;
something covert, i.e. a trick from H2664 (חָפַשׂ);
to spread loose; figuratively, to manumit a primitive root;
something spread loosely, i.e. a carpet from H2666 (חָפַשׁ);
liberty (from slavery) from H2666 (חָפַשׁ);
prostration by sickness and חׇפְשִׁית; from H2666 (חָפַשׁ); (with H1004 (בַּיִת), a hospital)
exempt (from bondage, tax or care) from H2666 (חָפַשׁ);

term: [phrase] archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.
definition: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear from H2686 (חָצַץ); also by interchange for H6086 (עֵץ)

term: cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.
definition: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave or חָצֵב; a primitive root;

term: divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle
definition: to cut or split in two; to halve a primitive root (compare H2086 (זֵד)));
Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia a collective form of H2691 (חָצֵר); village;
new Chatsor, a place in Palestine from H2674 (חָצוֹר) and a Aramaizing form of the feminine of H2319 (חָדָשׁ) (compare H2323 (חֲדָת));
the middle (of the night) from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה;

term: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.
definition: the half or middle from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה;
an arrow or חֵצִי; prolongation from H2671 (חֵץ);
Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth, an Israelite from H2677 (חֵצִי) and the plural of H4496 (מְנוּחָה), with the article interposed; midst of the resting-places;
a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth patronymically from H2679 (חֲצִי הַמְּנֻחוֹת);
a court or abode a collateral form of H2691 (חָצֵר);
grass; also a leek (collectively) perhaps originally the same as H2681 (חָצִיר), from the greenness of a courtyard;
the bosom (as comprised between the arms) from an unused root meaning to hold firmly;
{the bosom (as comprised between the arms)} a collateral form of H2683 (חֵצֶן), and meaning the same
properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe (Aramaic) a primitive root;

term: archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.
definition: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks);  to shoot an arrow a primitive root (compare H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from H2671 (חֵץ)
properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow from H2687 (חָצָץ);  also like H2671 (חֵץ)
Chatsetson-tamar, a place in Palestine or חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר; from H2686 (חָצַץ) and H8558 (תָּמָר); division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree;
a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note) by reduplication from H2690 (חָצַר);

to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from H2689 (חֲצֹצְרָה);
a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls) (masculine and feminine); from H2690 (חָצַר) in its original sense;
Chatsar-Addar, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H146 (אַדָּר); (the) village of Addar;
Chatsar-Gaddah, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a feminine of H1408 (גַּד); (the) village of (female) Fortune;
Chatsar-hat-Tikon, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H8484 (תִּיכוֹן) with the article interposed; village of the middle;
Chetsro, an Israelite by an orthographical variation for H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); enclosure;
Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites from H2691 (חָצֵר); court-yard;
a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron patronymically from H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן);
Chatseroth, a place in Palestine feminine plural of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards;
Chatserim, a place in Palestine plural masculine of H2691 (חָצֵר); yards;
Chatsarmaveth, a place in Arabia from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H4194 (מָוֶת); village of death;
Chatsar-Susah, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H5484 (סוּסָה); village of cavalry;
Chatsar-Susim, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the plural of H5483 (סוּס); village of horses;
Chatsar-Enon, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a derivative of H5869 (עַיִן); village of springs;
Chatsar-Enan, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the same as H5881 (עֵינָן); village of springs;
Chatsar-Shual, a place in Palestine from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H7776 (שׁוּעָל); village of (the) fox;

term: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.
definition: an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage) from H2710 (חָקַק);

term: carved work, portrayed, set a print.
definition: to carve; by implication, to delineate; also to entrench a primitive root;

term: appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.
definition: {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)} feminine of H2706 (חֹק), and meaning substantially the same
Chakupha, one of the Nethinim from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked;

term: appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.
definition: properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe a primitive root;
an enactment, a resolution from H2710 (חָקַק);
Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine or (fully) חוּקֹק; from H2710 (חָקַק); appointed;

term: find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.
definition: properly, to penetrate; hence, to examine intimately a primitive root;
examination, enumeration, deliberation from H2713 (חָקַר);
properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire; hence (figuratively) noble (in rank) or (fully) חוֹר; from H2787 (חָרַר); (compare H2751 (חֹרִי))
excrement from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels;

term: decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, [idiom] surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.
definition: to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill or חֲרֵב; a primitive root;
to demolish (Aramaic) a root corresponding to H2717 (חָרַב);

term: axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.
definition: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement from H2717 (חָרַב);
parched or ruined from H2717 (חָרַב);

term: desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.
definition: drought or desolation a collaterally form of H2719 (חֶרֶב);
Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains from H2717 (חָרַב); desolate;
properly, drought, i.e. (by implication) a desolation feminine of H2721 (חֹרֶב);
a desert feminine of H2720 (חָרֵב);
parching heat from H2717 (חָרַב);
Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes or חַרְבוֹנָה; of Persian origin;
properly, to leap suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to be dismayed a primitive root;
the leaping insect, i.e. a locust from H2727 (חָרַג);

term: be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.
definition: to shudder with terror; hence, to fear; also to hasten (with anxiety) a primitive root;
fearful; also reverential from H2729 (חָרַד);
fear, anxiety feminine of H2730 (חָרֵד);
Charadah, a place in the Desert the same as H2731 (חֲרָדָה);
a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod patrial from a derivative of H2729 (חָרַד) (compare H5878 (עֵין חֲרֹד));

term: be angry, burn, be displeased, [idiom] earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, [idiom] very, be wroth. See H8474 (תַּחָרָה).
definition: to glow or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to blaze up, of anger, zeal, jealousy a primitive root (compare H2787 (חָרַר));
Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert from H2356 (חוֹר) and a collateral (masculine) form of H1412 (גֻּדְגֹּדָה), with the article interposed; hole of the cleft;
Charhajah, an Israelite ; from H2734 (חָרָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); fearing Jah;
properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung) from an unused root meaning to perforate;
properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly;
Charumaph, an Israelite from passive participle of H2763 (חָרַם) and H639 (אַף); snub-nosed;
a burning of anger or (shortened) חָרֹן; from H2734 (חָרָה);
a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph) a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of H2756 (חָרִיף);

term: decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.
definition: properly, incised or (active) incisive; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a trench (as dug), gold (as mined), a threshing-sledge (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) determination; also eager or חָרֻץ; passive participle of H2782 (חָרַץ);
Charuts, an Israelite the same as H2742 (חֲרוּץ); earnest;
Charchur, one of the Nethinim a fuller form of H2746 (חַרְחֻר); inflammation;
Charchas, an Israelite from the same as H2775 (חֶרֶס); perhaps shining;
fever (as hot) from H2787 (חָרַר);
a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting from a primitive root meaning to engrave;
a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles) from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט);
{a horoscopist (as drawing magical lines or circles)} (Aramaic) the same as H2748 (חַרְטֹם)
a burning (i.e. intense) anger from H2734 (חָרָה);
white bread from the same as H2353 (חוּר);
a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean from H2356 (חוֹר); cave-dweller or troglodyte;
Chori, the name of two men or חוֹרִי; the same as H2752 (חֹרִי);
properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket or חָרִט; from the same as H2747 (חֶרֶט);
excrements of doves {or a vegetable} from the plural of H2716 (חֶרֶא) and the plural of H3123 (יוֹנָה); or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable
Chariph, the name of two Israelites from H2778 (חָרַף); autumnal;
properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut) or חֲרִץ; from H2782 (חָרַץ); (compare H2742 (חֲרוּץ))
ploughing or its season from H2790 (חָרַשׁ);
quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind) from H2790 (חָרַשׁ) in the sense of silence;
to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in anet a primitive root;
to scorch (Aramaic) a root probably allied to the equivalent of H2787 (חָרַר);
properly, a net, i.e. (by analogy) lattice from H2760 (חָרַךְ);

term: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
definition: to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose a primitive root;

term: (ac-) curse(-d, -d thing), dedicated thing, things which should have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction, devoted (thing), net.
definition: physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination or (Zechariah 14:11) חֶרֶם; from H2763 (חָרַם);
Chorem, a place in Palestine from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted;
Charim, an Israelite from H2763 (חָרַם); snub-nosed;
Chormah, a place in Palestine from H2763 (חָרַם); devoted;
Chermon, a mount of Palestine from H2763 (חָרַם); abrupt;
Hermons, i.e. its peaks plural of H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן);
a sickle (as cutting) from H2763 (חָרַם);

dry ground a variation of H3004 (יַבָּשָׁה);
dry land (Aramaic) corresponding to H3006 (יַבֶּשֶׁת);
Jigal, the name of three Israelites from H1350 (גָּאַל); avenger;
to dig or plow a primitive root;
a plowed field from H3009 (יָגַב);
Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan feminine from H1361 (גָּבַהּ); hillock;
Jigdaljah, an Israelite from H1431 (גָּדַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); magnified of Jah;

term: afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.
definition: to grieve a primitive root;
to push away a primitive root (probably rather the same as H3013 (יָגָה) through the common idea of dissatisfaction);
affliction from H3013 (יָגָה);
fearful from H3025 (יָגֹר);
Jagur, a place in Palestine probably from H1481 (גּוּר); a lodging;
toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor) from H3021 (יָגַע);
tired from H3021 (יָגַע);
Jogli, an Israelite from H1540 (גָּלָה); exiled;
properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil a primitive root;
earnings (as the product of toil) from H3021 (יָגַע);
tired; hence (transitive) tiresome from H3021 (יָגַע);
fatigue feminine of H3019 (יָגִיעַ);
to fear a primitive root;
Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to H7717 (שָׂהֵד); heap of the testimony;

term: ([phrase] be) able, [idiom] about, [phrase] armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, [idiom] bounty, [phrase] broad, (broken-) handed, [idiom] by, charge, coast, [phrase] consecrate, [phrase] creditor, custody, debt, dominion, [idiom] enough, [phrase] fellowship, force, [idiom] from, hand(-staves, -y work), [idiom] he, himself, [idiom] in, labour, [phrase] large, ledge, (left-) handed, means, [idiom] mine, ministry, near, [idiom] of, [idiom] order, ordinance, [idiom] our, parts, pain, power, [idiom] presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, [phrase] swear, terror, [idiom] thee, [idiom] by them, [idiom] themselves, [idiom] thine own, [idiom] thou, through, [idiom] throwing, [phrase] thumb, times, [idiom] to, [idiom] under, [idiom] us, [idiom] wait on, (way-) side, where, [phrase] wide, [idiom] with (him, me, you), work, [phrase] yield, [idiom] yourselves.
definition: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.), a primitive word; in distinction from H3709 (כַּף), the closed one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote (as follows)
{a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3027 (יָד)
to praise (Aramaic) corresponding to H3034 (יָדָה);
Jidalah, a place in Palestine of uncertain derivation;
Jidbash, an Israelite from the same as H1706 (דְּבַשׁ); perhaps honeyed;
properly, to handle, i.e. to throw, e.g. lots a primitive root; (compare H3034 (יָדָה))
properly, affection; concretely, a darling object from H3039 (יְדִיד);

physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands) a primitive root; used only as denominative from H3027 (יָד); literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand;
Jiddo, an Israelite from H3034 (יָדָה); praised;
Jadon, an Israelite from H3034 (יָדָה); thankful;
Jaddua, the name of two Israelites from H3045 (יָדַע); knowing;
Jeduthun, an Israelite or יְדֻתוּן; or יְדִיתוּן; probably from H3034 (יָדָה); laudatory;
loved from the same as H1730 (דּוֹד);
Jedidah, an Israelitess feminine of H3039 (יְדִיד); beloved;
Jedidejah, a name of Solomon from H3039 (יְדִיד) and H3050 (יָהּ); beloved of Jah;
Jedajah, the name of two Israelites from H3034 (יָדָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); praised of Jah;
Jediael, the name of three Israelites from H3045 (יָדַע) and H410 (אֵל); knowing God;
Jidlaph, a Mesopotamian from H1811 (דָּלַף); tearful;

term: acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, [idiom] could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, [phrase] be learned, [phrase] lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, [idiom] prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), [idiom] will be, wist, wit, wot.
definition: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.) a primitive root;

{to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3045 (יָדַע)
Jada, an Israelite from H3045 (יָדַע); knowing;
Jedajah, the name of two Israelites from H3045 (יָדַע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has known;
properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost from H3045 (יָדַע);

term: Jah, the Lord, most vehement. Compare names in '-iah,' '-jah.'
definition: Jah, the sacred name contraction for H3068 (יְהֹוָה), and meaning the same;

term: ascribe, bring, come on, give, go, set, take.
definition: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come a primitive root;

term: deliver, give, lay, [phrase] prolong, pay, yield.
definition: {to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3051 (יָהַב)
properly, what is given (by Providence), i.e. a lot from H3051 (יָהַב);
to Judaize, i.e. become Jewish denominative from a form corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד;
Jehud, a place in Palestine a briefer form of one corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד;
Jehdai, an Israelite perhaps from a form corresponding to H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד; Judaistic;
Jehudijah, a Jewess feminine of H3064 (יְהוּדִי);
Jehu, the name of five Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H1931 (הוּא); Jehovah (is) He;
Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H270 (אָחַז); Jehovah-seized;
Jehoash, the name of two Israelite kings from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and (perhaps) H784 (אֵשׁ); Jehovah-fired;
properly, Judah, hence, Judaea (Aramaic) contracted from a form corresponding to H3063 (יְהוּדָה);
a Jehudaite (or Judaite), i.e. Jew (Aramaic) patrial from H3061 (יְהוּד)lemma יְהיּד yod, corrected to יְהוּד;
Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory from H3034 (יָדָה); celebrated;
a Jehudite (i.e. Judaite or Jew), or descendant of Jehudah (i.e. Judah) patronymically from H3063 (יְהוּדָה);
Jehudi, an Israelite the same as H3064 (יְהוּדִי);
the Jewish (used adverbially) language feminine of H3064 (יְהוּדִי);
Jehudith, a Canaanitess the same as H3066 (יְהוּדִית); Jewess;

term: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
definition: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God from H1961 (הָיָה); (the) self-Existent or Eternal;

{YHWH} a variation of H3068 (יְהֹוָה) (used after H136 (אֲדֹנָי), and pronounced by Jews as H430 (אֱלֹהִים), in order to prevent the repetition of the same sound, since they elsewhere pronounce H3068 (יְהֹוָה) as H136 (אֲדֹנָי))
Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7200 (רָאָה); Jehovah will see (to it);
Jehovah-Nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the Desert from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5251 (נֵס) with the prononimal suffix; Jehovah (is) my banner;
Jehovah-Tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the Messiah and of Jerusalem from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H6664 (צֶדֶק) with pronominal suffix; Jehovah (is) our right;
Jehovah-Shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in Palestine from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); Jehovah (is) peace;
Jehovah-Shammah, a symbolic title of Jerusalem from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8033 (שָׁם) with directive enclitic; Jehovah (is) thither;
Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H2064 (זָבַד); Jehovah-endowed;
Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H2603 (חָנַן); Jehovah-favored;
Jehojada, the name of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3045 (יָדַע); Jehovah-known;
Jehojakin, a Jewish king from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3559 (כּוּן); Jehovah will establish;
Jehojakim, a Jewish king from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) abbreviated and H6965 (קוּם); Jehovah will raise;
Jehojarib, the name of two Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7378 (רִיב); Jehovah will contend;
Jehukal, an Israelite from H3201 (יָכֹל); potent;
Jehonadab, the name of an Israelite and of an Arab from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5068 (נָדַב); Jehovah-largessed;
Jehonathan, the name of four Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5414 (נָתַן); Jehovah-given;
Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob a fuller form of H3130 (יוֹסֵף);
Jehoaddah, an Israelite from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5710 (עָדָה); Jehovah-adorned;
Jehoaddin or Jehoaddan, an Israelitess or יְהוֹעַדָּן; from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5727 (עָדַן); Jehovahpleased;
Jehotsadak, an Israelite from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H6663 (צָדַק); Jehovah-righted;
Jehoram, the name of a Syrian and of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7311 (רוּם); Jehovah-raised;
Jehosheba, an Israelitess from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7650 (שָׁבַע); Jehovah-sworn;
Jehoshabath, an Israelitess a form of H3089 (יְהוֹשֶׁבַע);

term: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).
definition: Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader or יְהוֹשֻׁעַ; from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H3467 (יָשַׁע); Jehovah-saved;
Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites; also of a valley near Jerusalem from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8199 (שָׁפַט); Jehovah-judged;
elated; hence, arrogant probably from the same as H2022 (הַר);
Jehallelel, the name of two Israelites from H1984 (הָלַל) and H410 (אֵל); praising God;
a precious stone, probably onyx from H1986 (הָלַם) (in the sense of hardness);
Jahats or Jahtsah, a place East of the Jordan or יַהְצָה; or (feminine) יַהְצָה; from an unused root meaning to stamp; perhaps threshing-floor;
Joab, the name of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H1 (אָב); Jehovah-fathered;
Joach, the name of four Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H251 (אָח); Jehovahbrothered;
Joachaz, the name of two Israelites a form of H3059 (יְהוֹאָחָז);
Joel, the name of twelve Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H410 (אֵל); Jehovah (is his) God;
Joash, the name of six Israelites or יֹאָשׁ; (2 Chronicles 24:1), a form of H3060 (יְהוֹאָשׁ);
Job, an Israelite perhaps a form of H3103 (יוֹבָב), but more probably by erroneous transcription for H3437 (יָשׁוּב);
Jobab, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners from H2980 (יָבַב); howler;

the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced or יֹבֵל; apparently from H2986 (יָבַל);
a stream from H2986 (יָבַל);
Jubal, an antediluvian from H2986 (יָבַל); stream;
Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites a form of H3075 (יְהוֹזָבָד);
Jozacar, an Israelite from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H2142 (זָכַר); Jehovah-remembered;
Jocha, the name of two Israelites probably from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and a variation of H2421 (חָיָה); Jehovah-revived;
Jochanan, the name of nine Israelites a form of H3076 (יְהוֹחָנָן);
Jojada, the name of two Israelites a form of H3077 (יְהוֹיָדָע);
Jojakin, an Israelite king a form of H3078 (יְהוֹיָכִין);
Jojakim, an Israelite a form of H3079 (יְהוֹיָקִים);
Jojarib, the name of four Israelites a form of H3080 (יְהוֹיָרִיב);
Jokebed, the mother of Moses from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) contracted and H3513 (כָּבַד); Jehovah-gloried;
Jukal, an Israelite a form of H3081 (יְהוּכַל);

term: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
definition: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb) from an unused root meaning to be hot;
a day (Aramaic) corresponding to H3117 (יוֹם);
daily from H3117 (יוֹם);

Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן); effervescing (i.e. hot and active);
properly, dregs (as effervescing); hence, mud from the same as H3196 (יַיִן);
Jonadab, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite a form of H3082 (יְהוֹנָדָב);
a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating) probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן);
Jonah, an Israelite the same as H3123 (יוֹנָה);
a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan patronymically from H3121 (יָוֵן);
a sucker; hence, a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting) active participle of H3243 (יָנַק);
a sprout feminine of H3126 (יוֹנֵק);

dove of (the) silence (i.e. dumb Israel) of (i.e. among) distances (i.e. strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody) from H3123 (יוֹנָה) and H482 (אֵלֶם) and the plural of H7350 (רָחוֹק);
Jonathan, the name of ten Israelites a form of H3083 (יְהוֹנָתָן);
Joseph, the name of seven Israelites future of H3254 (יָסַף); let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding);
Josiphjah, an Israelite from active participle of H3254 (יָסַף) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) adding;
Joelah, an Israelite perhaps feminine active participle of H3276 (יַעַל); furthermore;
Joed, an Israelite apparently the active participle of H3259 (יָעַד); appointer;
Joezer, an Israelite from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5828 (עֵזֶר); Jehovah (is his) help;
Joash, the name of two Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5789 (עוּשׁ); Jehovahhastened;
Jotsadak, an Israelite a form of H3087 (יְהוֹצָדָק);
Jokim, an Israelite a form of H3113 (יוֹיָקִים);
sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers) active participle of H3384 (יָרָה);
Jorah, an Israelite from H3384 (יָרָה); rainy;
Jorai, an Israelite from H3384 (יָרָה); rainy;
Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian a form of H3088 (יְהוֹרָם);
Jushab-Chesed, an Israelite from H7725 (שׁוּב) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); kindness will be returned;
Josibjah, an Israelite from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jehovah will cause to dwell;
Joshah, an Israelite probably a form of H3145 (יוֹשַׁוְיָה);
Joshavjah, an Israelite from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H7737 (שָׁוָה); Jehovah-set;
Joshaphat, an Israelite a form of H3092 (יְהוֹשָׁפָט);
Jotham, the name of three Israelites from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H8535 (תָּם); Jehovah (is) perfect;
properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction active participle of H3498 (יָתַר);
Jezavel, an Israelite from an unused root (meaning to sprinkle) and H410 (אֵל); sprinkled of God;
Jizzijah, an Israelite from the same as the first part of H3149 (יְזַוְאֵל) and H3050 (יָהּ); sprinkled of Jah;
Jaziz, an Israelite from the same as H2123 (זִיז); he will make prominent;
Jizliah, an Israelite perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up); he will draw out;
Jezanjah, an Israelite or יְזַנְיָהוּ; probably for H2970 (יַאֲזַנְיָה);
sweat, i.e. (by implication) a sweating dress from an unused root mean to ooze;
a Jizrach (i.e. Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach a variation for H250 (אֶזְרָחִי);
Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites from H2224 (זָרַח) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will shine;
Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites from H2232 (זָרַע) and H410 (אֵל); God will sow;
a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel patronymically from H3157 (יִזְרְעֵאל);
a Jezreelitess feminine of H3158 (יִזְרְעֵאלִי);
Jechubbah, an Israelite from H2247 (חָבָה); hidden;
to be (or become) one a primitive root;

term: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.
definition: properly, a unit, i.e. (adverb) unitedly from H3161 (יָחַד);
Jachdo, an Israelite from H3162 (יַחַד) with pronominal suffix; his unity, i.e. (adverb) together;
Jachdiel, an Israelite from H3162 (יַחַד) and H410 (אֵל); unity of God;
Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites from H3162 (יַחַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); unity of Jah;
Jachaziel, the name of five Israelites from H2372 (חָזָה) and H410 (אֵל); beheld of God;
Jachzejah, an Israelite from H2372 (חָזָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will behold;
Jechezkel, the name of two Israelites from H2388 (חָזַק) and H410 (אֵל); God will strengthen;
Jechizkijah, the name of five Israelites or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from H3388 (יְרוּשָׁא) and H3050 (יָהּ); strengthened of Jah;
Jachzerah, an Israelite from the same as H2386 (חֲזִיר); perhaps protection;
Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites or (2 Chronicles 29:14) יְחַוְאֵל; from H2421 (חָיָה) and H410 (אֵל); God will live;
a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel patronymically from H3171 (יְחִיאֵל);
properly, united, i.e. sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced) from H3161 (יָחַד);
Jechijah, an Israelite from H2421 (חָיָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will live;
expectant from H3176 (יָחַל);

term: (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.
definition: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope a primitive root;
Jachleel, an Israelite from H3176 (יָחַל) and H410 (אֵל); expectant of God;
a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel patronymically from H3177 (יַחְלְאֵל);

term: get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.
definition: probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive a primitive root;
a kind of deer from H2560 (חָמַר);
Jachmai, an Israelite probably from H3179 (יָחַם); hot;
unsandalled from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes;
Jachtseel, an Israelite from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410 (אֵל); God will allot;
a Jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of Jachtseel patronymically from H3183 (יַחְצְאֵל);
Jachtsiel, an Israelite from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and H410 (אֵל); allotted of God;
to delay a primitive root;
