Jaroach, an Israelite perhaps denominative from H3394 (יָרֵחַ); (born at the) new moon;
green, i.e. an herb from H3417 (יָרָק);
Jerusha or Jerushah, as Israelitess or יְרוּשָׁה feminine passive participle of H3423 (יָרַשׁ); possessed;

Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine rarely יְרוּשָׁלַיִם; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of H3390 (יְרוּשָׁלֵם))); probably from (the passive participle of) H3384 (יָרָה) and H7999 (שָׁלַם); founded peaceful;
{Jerusalem} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3389 (יְרוּשָׁלַ͏ִם)
a lunation, i.e. month from a unused root of uncertain signification;
Jerach, an Arabian patriarch the same as H3391 (יֶרַח);
a month (Aramaic) corresponding to H3391 (יֶרַח);
the moon from the same as H3391 (יֶרַח);
Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites from H7355 (רָחַם); compassionate;
Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites from H7355 (רָחַם) and H410 (אֵל); God will compassionate;
a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel patronymically from H3396 (יְרַחְמְאֵל);
Jarcha, an Egyptian probably of Egyptian origin;
to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash a primitive root;
Jeriel, an Israelite from H3384 (יָרָה) and H410 (אֵל); thrown of God;
literally he will contend; properly, adjective, contentious; used as noun, an adversary from H7378 (רִיב);
Jarib, the name of three Israelites the same as H3401 (יָרִיב);
Jeribai, an Israelite from H3401 (יָרִיב); contentious;
Jerijah, an Israelite or יְרִיָּהוּ; from H3384 (יָרָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will throw;
Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine or יְרֵחוֹ; or variation (1 Kings 16:34) יְרִיחֹה; perhaps from H3394 (יָרֵחַ); its month; or else from H7306 (רוּחַ); fragrant;

term: Jermoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth (from the margin).
definition: Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites or יְרֵימוֹת; or יְרֵמוֹת; feminine plural from H7311 (רוּם); elevations;
a hanging (as tremulous) from H3415 (יָרַע);
Jerioth, an Israelitess plural of H3407 (יְרִיעָה); curtains;
the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side from an unused root meaning to be soft;
a thigh (Aramaic) corresponding to H3411 (יְרֵכָה);
properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess feminine of H3409 (יָרֵךְ);
Jarmuth, the name of two places in Palestine from H7311 (רוּם); elevation;
Jeremai, an Israelite from H7311 (רוּם); elevated;
Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites or יִרְמְיָהוּ; from H7311 (רוּם) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will rise;

term: be grevious (only Isaiah 15:4; the rest belong to H7489 (רָעַע)).
definition: properly, to be broken up (with any violent action) i.e. (figuratively) to fear a primitive root;
Jirpeel, a place in Palestine from H7495 (רָפָא) and H410 (אֵל); God will heal;
to spit a primitive root;
properly, pallor, i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure, i.e. grass or vegetation from H3417 (יָרָק) (in the sense of vacuity of color);
properly, green; concretely, a vegetable from the same as H3418 (יֶרֶק);
paleness, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought) from H3418 (יֶרֶק);
Jorkeam, a place in Palestine from H7324 (רוּק) and H5971 (עַם); people will be poured forth;
yellowishness from the same as H3418 (יֶרֶק);

term: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
definition: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin or יָרֵשׁ; a primitive root;
occupancy from H3423 (יָרַשׁ);
something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony from H3423 (יָרַשׁ);

term: (there) are, (he, it, shall, there, there may, there shall, there should) be, thou do, had, hast, (which) hath, (I, shalt, that) have, (he, it, there) is, substance, it (there) was, (there) were, ye will, thou wilt, wouldest.
definition: there is or are (or any other form of the verb to be, as may suit the connection) perhaps from an unused root meaning to stand out, or exist; entity; used adverbially or as a copula for the substantive verb (H1961 (הָיָה));

term: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.
definition: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry a primitive root;
Jeshebab, an Israelite from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H1 (אָב); seat of (his) father;
Joshebbash-Shebeth, an Israelite from the active participle of H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H7674 (שֶׁבֶת), with a preposition and the article interposed; sitting in the seat;
Jishbo-be-Nob, a Philistine from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H5011 (נֹב), with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob;
Jishbach, an Israelite from H7623 (שָׁבַח); he will praise;
a Jashubite, or descendant of Jashub patronymically from H3437 (יָשׁוּב);

term: Jashubi-lehem. (Prob. the text should be pointed יֹשְׁבֵי לֶחֶם and rendered '(they were) inhabitants of Lechem,' i.e. of Bethlehem (by contraction). Compare H3902 (לַחְמִי)).
definition: Jashubi-Lechem, an Israelite from H7725 (שׁוּב) and H3899 (לֶחֶם); returner of bread;
Jashobam, the name of two or three Israelites from H7725 (שׁוּב) and H5971 (עַם); people will return;
Jishbak, a son of Abraham from an unused root corresponding to H7662 (שְׁבַק); he will leave;
Joshbekashah, an Israelite from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H7186 (קָשֶׁה); a hard seat;
Jashub, the name of two Israelites or יָשִׁיב; from H7725 (שׁוּב); he will return;
Jishvah, an Israelite from H7737 (שָׁוָה); he will level;
Jeshochajah, an Israelite from the same as H3445 (יֶשַׁח) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will empty;
Jishvi, the name of two Israelites from H7737 (שָׁוָה); level;
a Jishvite (collectively) or descendants of Jishvi patronymically from H3440 (יִשְׁוִי);
Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine for H3091 (יְהוֹשׁוּעַ); he will save;
{Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ)

term: deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.
definition: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity feminine passive participle of H3467 (יָשַׁע);
hunger from an unused root meaning to gape (as the empty stomach);
Jischak, the heir of Abraham from H7831 (שַׁחֲצוֹם); he will laugh;
to extend a primitive root;
Jishai, David's father by Aramaic אִישַׁי; from the same as H3426 (יֵשׁ); extant;
Jishshijah, the name of five Israelites or יִשִּׁיָּהוּ; from H5383 (נָשָׁה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will lend;
Jesimael, an Israelite from H7760 (שׂוּם) and H410 (אֵל); God will place;
desolation from H3456 (יָשַׁם);
a desolation from H3456 (יָשַׁם);
an old man from H3486 (יָשֵׁשׁ);
Jeshishai, an Israelite from H3453 (יָשִׁישׁ); aged;
to place; intransitively, to be placed a primitive root;
to lie waste a primitive root;
Jishma, an Israelite from H3456 (יָשַׁם); desolate;
Jishmael, the name of Abraham's oldest son, and of five Israelites from H8085 (שָׁמַע) and H410 (אֵל); God will hear;
a Jishmaelite or descendant of Jishmael patronymically from H3458 (יִשְׁמָעֵאל);
Jishmajah, the name of two Israelites or יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּlemma יְשְׁמַעְיָהוּ first vowel, corrected to יִשְׁמַעְיָהוּ; from H8085 (שָׁמַע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will hear;
Jishmerai, an Israelite from H8104 (שָׁמַר); preservative;
properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate a primitive root;
sleepy from H3462 (יָשֵׁן);
Jashen, an Israelite the same as H3463 (יָשֵׁן);
old from H3462 (יָשֵׁן);
Jeshanah, a place in Palestine feminine of H3465 (יָשָׁן);

term: [idiom] at all, avenging, defend, deliver(-er), help, preserve, rescue, be safe, bring (having) salvation, save(-iour), get victory.
definition: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor a primitive root;
liberty, deliverance, prosperity or יֵשַׁע; from H3467 (יָשַׁע);
Jishi, the name of four Israelites from H3467 (יָשַׁע); saving;
Jeshajah, the name of seven Israelites or יְשַׁעְיָהוּ; from H3467 (יָשַׁע) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has saved;
a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name) from an unused root meaning to polish;
Jishpah, an Israelite perhaps from H8192 (שָׁפָה); he will scratch;
Jishpan, an Israelite probably from the same as H8227 (שָׁפָן); he will hide;

term: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).
definition: to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous a primitive root;
Jesher, an Israelite from H3474 (יָשַׁר); the right;
the right from H3474 (יָשַׁר);

term: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), [phrase] pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).
definition: straight (literally or figuratively) from H3474 (יָשַׁר);
Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity from H8280 (שָׂרָה) and H410 (אֵל); he will rule as God;
{Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל)
Jesarelah, an Israelite by variation from H3477 (יָשָׁר) and H410 (אֵל) with directive enclitic; right towards God;
a Jisreelite or descendant of Jisrael patronymically from H3478 (יִשְׂרָאֵל);
a Jisreelitess or female descendant of Jisrael feminine of H3481 (יִשְׂרְאֵלִי);
rectitude feminine of H3477 (יָשָׁר);
Jeshurun, a symbolic name for Israel from H3474 (יָשַׁר); upright;
Jissaskar, a son of Jacob (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7939 (שָׂכָר); he will bring a reward;
gray-haired, i.e. an aged man from an unused root meaning to blanch;
a sign of the object of a verb (Aramaic) corresponding to H853 (אֵת);
to sit or dwell (Aramaic) corresponding to H3427 (יָשַׁב);
a peg from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast;
a bereaved person from an unused root meaning to be lonely;
properly, what is left, i.e. (by implication) a gleaning passive participle of H3498 (יָתַר);
Jattir, a place in Palestine from H3498 (יָתַר); redundant;
preeminent; as an adverb, very (Aramaic) corresponding to H3492 (יַתִּיר);
Jithlah, a place in Palestine probably from H8518 (תָּלָה); it will hang, i.e. be high;
Jithmah, an Israelite from the same as H3490 (יָתוֹם); orphanage;
Jathniel, an Israelite from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410 (אֵל); continued of God;
Jithnan, a place in Palestine from the same as H8577 (תַּנִּין); extensive;

term: excel, leave (a remnant), left behind, too much, make plenteous, preserve, (be, let) remain(-der, -ing, -nant), reserve, residue, rest.
definition: to jut over or exceed; by implication, to excel; (intransitively) to remain or be left; causatively, to leave, cause to abound, preserve a primitive root;

term: [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.
definition: properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free) from H3498 (יָתַר);
Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite the same as H3499 (יֶתֶר);
Jithra, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite) by variation for H3502 (יִתְרָה);
properly, excellence, i.e. (by implication) wealth feminine of H3499 (יֶתֶר);
Jethro, Moses' father-in-law from H3499 (יֶתֶר) with pron. suffix; his excellence;
preeminence, gain from H3498 (יָתַר);
a Jithrite or descendant of Jether patronymically from H3500 (יֶתֶר);
Jithran, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite from H3498 (יָתַר); excellent;
Jithream, a son of David from H3499 (יֶתֶר) and H5971 (עַם); excellence of people;
the lobe or flap of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging) feminine active participle of H3498 (יָתַר);
Jetheth, an Edomite of uncertain derivation;

term: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.
definition: properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil a primitive root;
suffering (physical or mental), adversity from H3510 (כָּאַב);
to despond; causatively, to deject a primitive root;

term: abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, [idiom] be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, [idiom] more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.
definition: to be heavy, i.e. in a bad sense (burdensome, severe, dull) or in a good sense (numerous, rich, honorable; causatively, to make weighty (in the same two senses) or כָּבֵד; a primitive root;
weight, multitude, vehemence from H3513 (כָּבַד);

term: (so) great, grievous, hard(-ened), (too) heavy(-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.
definition: heavy; figuratively in a good sense (numerous) or in a bad sense (severe, difficult, stupid) from H3513 (כָּבַד);
the liver (as the heaviest of the viscera) the same as H3515 (כָּבֵד);
difficulty feminine of H3515 (כָּבֵד);
to expire or (causatively) to extinguish (fire, light, anger) a primitive root;
properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness rarely כָּבֹד; from H3513 (כָּבַד);
weightiness, i.e. magnificence, wealth irregular feminine passive participle of H3513 (כָּבַד);
Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile;
Cabon, a place in Palestine from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly;
a matrass (of intertwined materials) from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting;

term: [phrase] feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.
definition: vast, whether in extent (figuratively, of power, mighty; of time, aged), or in number, many from H3527 (כָּבַר);
a fetter from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together;
to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative a primitive root;
properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate) a primitive root;
properly, extent of time, i.e. a great while; hence, long ago, formerly, hitherto from H3527 (כָּבַר);
Kebar, a river of Mesopotamia the same as H3528 (כְּבָר); length;
properly, length, i.e. a measure (of uncertain dimension) feminine of H3528 (כְּבָר);
a sieve (as netted) from H3527 (כָּבַר) in its original sense;
a ram (just old enough to butt) from an unused root meaning to dominate;

term: bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.
definition: to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate a primitive root;
a footstool (as trodden upon) from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ);
a ewe or כַּבְשָׂה; feminine of H3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ);
a smelting furnace (as reducing metals) from H3533 (כָּבַשׁ);
properly, a pail; but generally of earthenware; a jar  for domestic purposes from an unused root meaning to deepen;
false (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576 (כָּזַב);
a sparkling gem, probably the ruby from the same as H3537 (כַּד) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged;
Kedorlaomer, an early Persian king of foreign origin;

term: also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.
definition: properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now from the prefix k and H1931 (הוּא);
{properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3541 (כֹּה)

term: darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, [idiom] utterly.
definition: to be weak, i.e. (figuratively) to despond (causatively, rebuke), or (of light, the eye) to grow dull a primitive root;

term: somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.
definition: feeble, obscure from H3543 (כָּהָה);
properly, a weakening; figuratively, alleviation, i.e. cure feminine of H3544 (כֵּהֶה);
to be able (Aramaic) a root corresponding to and H3557 (כּוּל);

term: deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest('s office).
definition: to officiate as a priest; figuratively, to put on regalia a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548 (כֹּהֵן);

term: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.
definition: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman) active participle of H3547 (כָּהַן);
{one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3548 (כֹּהֵן)
priesthood from H3547 (כָּהַן);
a window (as a perforation) (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3854 (לַהַג) in the sense of piercing;
Kub, a country near Egypt of foreign derivation;
a helmet (as arched) from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded;
properly, to prick or penetrate; hence, to blister (as smarting or eating into) a primitive root;
a branding from H3554 (כָּוָה);
a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince probably from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן) (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (כָּוָה) (in the sense of blazing);

term: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).
definition: properly, to keep in; hence, to measure; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses) a primitive root;
a jewel (probably gold beads) from an unused root meaning to store away;

term: certain(-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, [idiom] very deed.
definition: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous) a primitive root;
Kun, a place in Syria probably from H3559 (כּוּן); established;
something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer from H3559 (כּוּן);
Conanjah, the name of two Israelites from H3559 (כּוּן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sustained;
a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye) from an unused root meaning to hold together;
a pot or furnace (as if excavated) from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through;
Cor-Ashan, a place in Palestine from H3564 (כּוּר) and H6227 (עָשָׁן); furnace of smoke;
Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians;
{Koresh (or Cyrus), the Persian king} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3566 (כּוֹרֶשׁ)
Cush (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite probably of foreign origin;
a Cushite, or descendant of Cush patronymically from H3568 (כּוּשׁ);
Cushi, the name of two Israelites the same as H3569 (כּוּשִׁי);
a Cushite woman feminine of H3569 (כּוּשִׁי);
Cushan, a region of Arabia perhaps from H3568 (כּוּשׁ);
Cushan-Rishathajim, a Mesopotamian king apparently from H3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of H7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness;
prosperity; in plural freedom from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר);
Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria or (feminine) כּוּתָה; of foreign origin;

term: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.
definition: to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively a primitive root;

term: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.
definition: falsehood; literally (untruth) or figuratively (idol) from H3576 (כָּזַב);
Cozeba, a place in Palestine from H3576 (כָּזַב); fallacious;
Cozbi, a Midianitess from H3576 (כָּזַב); false;
Kezib, a place in Palestine from H3576 (כָּזַב); falsified;

term: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
definition: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm;
to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy a primitive root;
to paint (with stibium) a primitive root;

term: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.
definition: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe) a primitive root;
literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy from H3584 (כָּחַשׁ);
faithless from H3584 (כָּחַשׁ);
a brand or scar from H3554 (כָּוָה);

term: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
definition: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent;
a crushing; figuratively, calamity from a primitive root meaning to strike;
properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck) from the same as H3589 (כִּיד) (compare H3539 (כַּדְכֹּד));
properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית)
Kidon, a place in Palestine the same as H3591 (כִּידוֹן);
perhaps tumult of uncertain derivation;
properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor) from H3559 (כּוּן);

properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform or כִּיֹּר; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר);
niggardly or כֵּלַי; from H3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding;
a club or sledge-hammer from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise;
a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades from the same as H3558 (כּוּמָז);
a cup; also a bag formoney or weights a form for H3563 (כּוֹס);
a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set) a form for H3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual);
literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of adistaff, by which it is twirled from H3787 (כָּשֵׁר); compare H6418 (פֶּלֶךְ)

term: after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.
definition: just so, referring to the previous or following context from H3541 (כֹּה);
a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin) from H3769 (כָּרַר);
a talent (Aramaic) corresponding to H3603 (כִּכָּר);

term: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
definition: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense) or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from H3634 (כָּלַל);

term: all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be-(for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.
definition: {properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3605 (כֹּל)

term: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.
definition: to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit) a primitive root;
a prison from H3607 (כָּלָא);
Kilab, an Israelite apparently from H3607 (כָּלָא) and H1 (אָב); restraint of (his) father;
two heterogeneities dual of H3608 (כֶּלֶא) in the original sense of separation;
a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack;
Caleb, the name of three Israelites perhaps a form of H3611 (כֶּלֶב), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible;
Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct) from H3612 (כָּלֵב) and H672 (אֶפְרָת);
a Calebite or descendant of Caleb probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from H3612 (כָּלֵב);

term: accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, [idiom] fully, [idiom] have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.
definition: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume) a primitive root;
pining from H3615 (כָּלָה);

term: altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.
definition: a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction from H3615 (כָּלָה);
a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife from H3634 (כָּלַל);
a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage) from the same as H3611 (כֶּלֶב);
Kelub, the name of two Israelites the same as H3619 (כְּלוּב)xlit kᵉlûb corrected to kᵉlûwb;
Kelubai, an Israelite a form of H3612 (כָּלֵב);
Keluhai, an Israelite from H3615 (כָּלָה); completed;
bridehood (only in the plural) denominative passive participle from H3618 (כַּלָּה)lemma כַּלָה missing dagesh, corrected to כַּלָּה;
maturity from an unused root meaning to be complete;
Kelach, a place in Assyria the same as H3624 (כֶּלַח);
Col-Chozeh, an Israelite from H3605 (כֹּל) and H2374 (חֹזֶה); every seer;

term: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.
definition: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon) from H3615 (כָּלָה);
a prison or כְּלוּא; from H3627 (כְּלִי) (compare H3608 (כֶּלֶא));
a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self) feminine of H3627 (כְּלִי) (only in the plural);
Kiljon, an Israelite a form of H3631 (כִּלָּיוֹן);
pining, destruction from H3615 (כָּלָה);

term: all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.
definition: complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully from H3634 (כָּלַל);
Calcol, an Israelite from H3557 (כּוּל); sustenance;
to complete a primitive root;
to complete (Aramaic) corresponding to H3634 (כָּלַל);
Kelal, an Israelite from H3634 (כָּלַל); complete;

term: be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.
definition: properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult a primitive root;
Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire of foreign derivation;
disgrace from H3637 (כָּלַם);
disgrace from H3639 (כְּלִמָּה);
Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation;
to pine after a primitive root;
Kimham, an Israelite from H3642 (כָּמַהּ); pining;

term: according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.
definition: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as, thus, so or כָּמוֹ; (compare H3651 (כֵּן));
Kemosh, the god of the Moabites or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful;
'cummin' (from its use as a condiment) from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve;
to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory a primitive root;
properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity) a primitive root;
properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural) from H3648 (כָּמַר);
obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light, i.e. an eclipse (only in plural) redupl. from H3648 (כָּמַר);

term: [phrase] after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, [phrase] (for-) asmuch as yet, [phrase] be (for which) cause, [phrase] following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), [idiom] the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, [phrase] there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, [idiom] you.
definition: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles) from H3559 (כּוּן);
so (Aramaic) corresponding to H3651 (כֵּן);

term: base, estate, foot, office, place, well.
definition: a stand, i.e. pedestal or station the same as H3651 (כֵּן), used as a noun;
a gnat from H3661 (כָּנַן) in the sense of fastening; (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregular in Exodus 8:17,18; Hebrews 13:14))
to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize a primitive root;
Canneh, a place in Assyria for H3641 (כַּלְנֶה);
a plant (as set) from H3661 (כָּנַן);
a harp from a unused root meaning to twang;
Conjah, an Israelite king for H3204 (יְכׇנְיָה);
so or thus (Aramaic) corresponding to H3644 (כְּמוֹ);
to set out, i.e. plant a primitive root;
Kenani, an Israelite from H3661 (כָּנַן); planted;
Kenanjah, an Israelite or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from H3661 (כָּנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has planted;
to collect; hence, to enfold a primitive root;

term: bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.
definition: properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish a primitive root;
a package from H3665 (כָּנַע) in the sense of folding (compare H3664 (כָּנַס));
Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him from H3665 (כָּנַע); humiliated;
Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites feminine of H3667 (כְּנַעַן);
a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans) patrial from H3667 (כְּנַעַן);
properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw a primitive root;

term: [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).
definition: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle from H3670 (כָּנַף);

Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658 (כִּנּוֹר); perhaps harp-shaped;
to assemble (Aramaic) corresponding to H3664 (כָּנַס);
a colleague (as having the same title) from H3655 (כָּנָה);
{a colleague (as having the same title)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3674 (כְּנָת)
{a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token} apparently a contraction for H3678 (כִּסֵּא), but probably by erroneous transcription for H5251 (נֵס)
properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival or כֶּסֶה; apparently from H3680 (כָּסָה);
properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied) or כִּסֵּה; from H3680 (כָּסָה);
{a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people} for H3778 (כַּשְׂדִּי)

term: clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare H3780 (כָּשָׂה).
definition: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy) a primitive root;
properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering passive participle of H3680 (כָּסָה);
a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling from H3680 (כָּסָה);
to cut off a primitive root;
properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly from H3688 (כָּסַל);
any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one) the same as H3684 (כְּסִיל);
Kesil, a place in Palestine the same as H3684 (כְּסִיל);
silliness from H3684 (כְּסִיל);
properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly a primitive root;
properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust from H3688 (כָּסַל);
in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness feminine of H3689 (כֶּסֶל);
Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month probably of foreign origin;
Kislon, an Israelite from H3688 (כָּסַל); hopeful;
Kesalon, a place in Palestine from H3688 (כָּסַל); fertile;
Kesulloth, a place in Palestine feminine plural of passive participle of H3688 (כָּסַל); fattened;
Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians a plural probably of foreign derivation;
Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine from the feminine plural of H3689 (כֶּסֶל) and H8396 (תָּבוֹר); flanks of Tabor;
to shear a primitive root;
spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn) from H3697 (כָּסַם);
to estimate a primitive root;
properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear a primitive root;
silver (from its pale color); by implication, money from H3700 (כָּסַף);
{silver (from its pale color); by implication, money} (Aramaic) corresponding to H3701 (כֶּסֶף)
Casiphja, a place in Babylon perhaps from H3701 (כֶּסֶף); silvery;
a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed) from H3680 (כָּסָה);
now (Aramaic) probably from H3652 (כֵּן);
thus (only in the formula 'and so forth') (Aramaic) or כְּעֶת; (Aramaic), feminine of H3705 (כְּעַן);

term: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.
definition: to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant a primitive root;

term: anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, [idiom] sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.
definition: vexation or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from H3707 (כַּעַס);

term: branch, [phrase] foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.
definition: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power from H3721 (כָּפַף);
a hollow rock from H3721 (כָּפַף);
properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue a primitive root;
a leaf of a palmtree feminine of H3709 (כַּף);
properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground) from H3722 (כָּפַר);
a girder from an unused root meaning to connect;
a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane) from H3722 (כָּפַר);
Kephirah, a place in Palestine feminine of H3715 (כְּפִיר); the village (always with the art.);
to fold together; figuratively, to repeat a primitive root;
a duplicate from H3717 (כָּפַל);
to bend a primitive root;
hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain) from H3719 (כָּפַן);
to curve a primitive root;

term: appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).
definition: to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel a primitive root;
a village (as protected by walls) from H3722 (כָּפַר);

term: bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.
definition: properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price from H3722 (כָּפַר);
expiation (only in plural) from H3722 (כָּפַר);
Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine from H3723 (כָּפָר) and H5984 (עַמּוֹנִי), with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite;
a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark) from H3722 (כָּפַר);
to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate a primitive root;
to fetter (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence;

a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle;
Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as H3730 (כַּפְתֹּר);
a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor patrial from H3731 (כַּפְתֹּר);

term: captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also H1033 (בֵּית כַּר), H3746 (כָּרִי).
definition: a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out) from H3769 (כָּרַר) in the sense of plumpness;
properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry from the same as H3564 (כּוּר);
to grieve (Aramaic) probably corresponding to H3738 (כָּרָה) in the sense of piercing(figuratively);
to gird or clothe from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל);
a mantle (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of H3736 (כַּרְבֵּל);
properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open a primitive root;
to purchase usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of H3738 (כָּרָה) (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain);
a purchase from H3739 (כָּרָה);
a meadow feminine of H3733 (כַּר);
a cherub or imaginary figure of uncertain derivation;
Kerub, a place in Babylon the same as H3742 (כְּרוּב);
a herald (Aramaic) from H3745 (כְּרַז);
to proclaim (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin;
a life-guardsman perhaps an abridged plural of H3733 (כַּר) in the sense of leader (of the flock);
Kerith, a brook of Palestine from H3772 (כָּרַת); a cut;
a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce from H3772 (כָּרַת);
a rim or top margin expanded from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן);
the crocus probably of foreign origin;
Karkemish, a place in Syria of foreign derivation;
Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes of Persian origin;
a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing) from H3769 (כָּרַר);

term: vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also H1021 (בֵּית הַכֶּרֶם).
definition: a garden or vineyard from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

term: vine dresser (as one or two words).
definition: a vinedresser active participle of an imaginary denominative from H3754 (כֶּרֶם);
Karmi, the name of three Israelites from H3754 (כֶּרֶם); gardener;
a Karmite or descendant of Karmi patronymically from H3756 (כַּרְמִי);
carmine, a deep red probably of foreign origin;

term: full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).
definition: a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce from H3754 (כֶּרֶם);
Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine the same as H3759 (כַּרְמֶל);
a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town) patron from H3760 (כַּרְמֶל);
a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel feminine of H3761 (כַּרְמְלִי);
Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean of uncertain derivation;
a throne (Aramaic) corresponding to H3678 (כִּסֵּא);
to lay waste from H3697 (כָּסַם);

term: bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, [idiom] very.
definition: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate a primitive root;
the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual) from H3766 (כָּרַע);
byssus or fine vegetable wool of foreign origin;
to dance (i.e. whirl) a primitive root;
the paunch or belly (as swelling out) by variation from H7164 (קָרַס);
Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes of foreign origin;

term: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
definition: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces) a primitive root;
something cut, i.e. a hewn timber passive participle feminine of H3772 (כָּרַת);
a Kerethite or life-guardsman probably from H3772 (כָּרַת) in the sense of executioner; (compare H2876 (טַבָּח)) (only collectively in the singular as plural)
a young sheep apparently by transposition for H3532 (כֶּבֶשׂ);
a young ewe feminine of H3775 (כֶּשֶׂב);
Kesed, a relative of Abraham from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from H3777 (כֶּשֶׂד) (only in the plural);
a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer (Aramaic) corresponding to H3778 (כַּשְׂדִּי);
to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh) a primitive root;
properly, a feller, i.e. an axe from H3782 (כָּשַׁל);

term: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.

definition: to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize a primitive root;

term: (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.
definition: to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back a primitive root;
a mound, i.e. wave from H5110 (נוּד) in the sense of piling up;

term: offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).
definition: to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously a primitive root;
be (or give) liberal(-ly) (Aramaic) corresponding to H5068 (נָדַב);
Nadab, the name of four Israelites from H5068 (נָדַב); liberal;

term: free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).
definition: properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift from H5068 (נָדַב);
Nedabjah, an Israelite from H5068 (נָדַב) and H3050 (יָהּ); largess of Jah;
a layer (of building materials) (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick;

term: chase (away), [idiom] could not, depart, flee ([idiom] apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).
definition: properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away a primitive root;
to depart (Aramaic) corresponding to H5074 (נָדַד);
properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed) passive participle of H5074 (נָדַד);

term: cast out, drive, put far away.
definition: properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root;
a bounty (for prostitution) from H5077 (נָדָה) in the sense of freely flinging money;

term: [idiom] far, filthiness, [idiom] flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, [idiom] removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).
definition: properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest) from H5074 (נָדַד);

term: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.
definition: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.) a primitive root;
properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant) from H5068 (נָדַב);
properly, nobility, i.e. reputation feminine of H5081 (נָדִיב);
a present (for prostitution) probably from an unused root meaning to give;
a sheath (of a sword) of uncertain derivation;
a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul) (Aramaic) from the same as H5084 (נָדָן);

term: drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.
definition: to shove asunder, i.e. disperse a primitive root;
to promise (pos., to do or give something to God) a primitive root;
a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised or נֵדֶר; from H5087 (נָדַר);
lamentation from an unused root meaning to lament;

term: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).
definition: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh a primitive root;
to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation) a primitive root;
an elegy from H5091 (נָהָה);
lamentation feminine of H5092 (נְהִי);
illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as H5105 (נְהָרָה);
properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain a primitive root;
Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine or נַהֲלֹל; the same as H5097 (נַהֲלֹל);
pasture from H5095 (נָהַל);
to growl a primitive root;
a snarl from H5098 (נָהַם);
snarling feminine of H5099 (נַהַם);
to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger) a primitive root;
to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble a primitive root;
a river, especially the Euphrates (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5102 (נָהַר);
a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity from H5102 (נָהַר);
daylight from H5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense;

term: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.
definition: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize a primitive root;
to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter a primitive root;
produce, literally or figuratively or נֵיב; from H5107 (נוּב);
Nobai, an Israelite from H5108 (נוֹב); fruitful;

term: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.
definition: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt a primitive root;
to flee (Aramaic) corresponding to H5116 (נָוֶה);
exile (only defective נֹד ); from H5110 (נוּד);
Nod, the land of Cain the same as H5112 (נוֹד)lemma נוֹדּ extra dagesh, corrected to נוֹד; vagrancy;
Nodab, an Arab tribe from H5068 (נָדַב); noble;

term: keept at home, prepare an habitation.
definition: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises) a primitive root; (compare H5116 (נָוֶה))

term: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.
definition: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den) or (feminine) נָוָה; from H5115 (נָוָה);

term: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).
definition: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.) a primitive root;
quiet or נוֹחַ; from H5117 (נוּחַ);
Nochah, an Israelite feminine of H5118 (נוּחַ); quietude;
to quake
Navith, a place in Palestine from H5115 (נָוָה); residence;
a sink (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul;
to slumber (from drowsiness) a primitive root;
sleepiness from H5123 (נוּם);
to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual a primitive root;
Nun or Non, the father of Joshua or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from H5125 (נוּן); perpetuity,

term: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.
definition: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver) a primitive root;

term: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
definition: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined) a primitive root;
Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess from H3259 (יָעַד) and H3050 (יָהּ); convened of Jah;

term: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.
definition: to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.) a primitive root;
elevation from H5130 (נוּף);
properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion) a primitive root;
a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of H5327 (נָצָה) in the sense of flying;
to suckle a primitive root;
fire (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of H5216 (נִיר)) meaning to shine;
to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed a primitive root;
to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation) a primitive root;
something boiled, i.e. soup from H2102 (זוּד);

term: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.
definition: separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite) or נָזִר; from H5144 (נָזַר);

term: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.
definition: to drip, or shed by trickling a primitive root;
a nose-ring from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of H5143 (נֵזֶק);
loss from an unused root meaning to injure;

to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote a primitive root;

properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty) or נֵזֶר; from H5144 (נָזַר);
Noach, the patriarch of the flood the same as H5118 (נוּחַ); rest;
Nachbi, an Israelite from H2247 (חָבָה); occult;

term: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.
definition: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists) a primitive root;
Nechum, an Israelite from H5162 (נָחַם); comforted;
properly, consoled; abstractly, solace or נִחֻם; from H5162 (נָחַם);
Nachum, an Israelite prophet from H5162 (נָחַם); comfortable;
Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer;

coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard apparently passive participle of H5172 (נָחַשׁ) (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (H5175 (נָחָשׁ), as denominative) when hissing);
copper or נְחֻשָׁה; feminine of H5153 (נָחוּשׁ);
a flute probably denominative from H2485 (חָלִיל);
a nostril from the same as H5170 (נַחַר);

definition: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate a primitive root;

a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine) or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from H5157 (נָחַל) in its original sense;

term: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).
definition: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion from H5157 (נָחַל) (in its usual sense);
Nachaliel, a place in the Desert from H5158 (נַחַל) and H410 (אֵל); valley of God;
a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed;
properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself) a primitive root;
Nacham, an Israelite from H5162 (נָחַם); consolation;
ruefulness, i.e. desistance from H5162 (נָחַם);
consolation from H5162 (נָחַם);
Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites from H5162 (נָחַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); consolation of Jah;
Nachamani, an Israelite from H5162 (נָחַם); consolatory;
we for H587 (אֲנַחְנוּ);
to be urgent a primitive root;
a snorting and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore;
Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite or נַחְרַי; from the same as H5170 (נַחַר); snorer;

term: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.
definition: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate a primitive root;
an incantation or augury from H5172 (נָחַשׁ);
copper (Aramaic) corresponding to H5154 (נְחוּשָׁה);
a snake (from its hiss) from H5172 (נָחַשׁ);
Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite the same as H5175 (נָחָשׁ);
Nachshon, an Israelite from H5172 (נָחַשׁ); enchanter;

term: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.
definition: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver) for H5154 (נְחוּשָׁה);
Nechushta, an Israelitess from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת); copper;
something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert from H5178 (נְחֹשֶׁת);

term: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

definition: to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose (Aramaic) corresponding to H5181 (נָחַת);

term: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.
definition: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness from H5182 (נְחַת); also (intransitively; perhaps from H5117 (נוּחַ))
Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites the same as H5183 (נַחַת); quiet;
descending from H5181 (נָחַת);

term: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
definition: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application a primitive root;
laden from H5190 (נָטַל);
a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls) from H5197 (נָטַף);
a tendril (as an offshoot) from H5203 (נָטַשׁ);
to lift; by implication, to impose a primitive root;
to raise (Aramaic) corresponding to H5190 (נָטַל);
a burden ; from H5190 (נָטַל);
properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting from H5193 (נָטַע);
a plant from H5193 (נָטַע);
Netaim, a place in Palestine plural of H5194 (נֶטַע);
to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration a primitive root;
a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte) from H5197 (נָטַף);
Netophah, a place in Palestine from H5197 (נָטַף); distillation;
a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah patronymic from H5199 (נְטֹפָה);
to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger) a primitive root;
to retain (Aramaic) corresponding to H5201 (נָטַר);

term: cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.
definition: properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.) a primitive root;
lamentation a doubtful word; apparently from H5091 (נָהָה);
motion (of the lips in speech) from H5110 (נוּד);
removal, i.e. exile feminine of H5205 (נִיד);
properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight or נִיחֹחַ; from H5117 (נוּחַ);
pleasure (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to H5207 (נִיחוֹחַ);
progeny from H5125 (נוּן);
Nineveh, the capital of Assyria of foreign origin;
fugitive from H5127 (נוּס);
Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year probably of foreign origin;
a spark from H5340 (נָצַץ);
to till the soil a root probably identical with that of H5216 (נִיר), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow;
properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land or נִר; from H5214 (נִיר);
a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively) or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see H5214 (נִיר); H5135 (נוּר)) properly, meaning to glisten;
to smite, i.e. drive away a primitive root;
smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted or נָכָא; from H5217 (נָכָא);
properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered) from H5218 (נָכֵא);
offspring from an unused root meaning to propagate;

term: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.
definition: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
a smiter, i.e. (figuratively) traducer from H5221 (נָכָה);
smitten, i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected
Neko, an Egyptian king probably of Egyptian origin;
Nakon, probably an Israelite from H3559 (כּוּן); prepared;
properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite from an unused root meaning to be straightforward;
properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of from the same as H5226 (נֵכַח);
straightforward, i.e. (figuratively), equitable, correct, or (abstractly), integrity from the same as H5226 (נֵכַח);
properly, straightforwardness, i.e. (figuratively) integrity, or (concretely) a truth feminine of H5228 (נָכֹחַ);
to defraud, i.e. act treacherously a primitive root;
deceit from H5230 (נָכַל);
{treasure} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5233 (נֶכֶס)
treasure from an unused root meaning to accumulate;

definition: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning) a primitive root;
something strange, i.e. unexpected calamity or נֹכֶר; from H5234 (נָכַר);
foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom ' from H5234 (נָכַר);
strange, in a variety of degrees and applications (foreign, non-relative, adulterous, different, wonderful) from H5235 (נֶכֶר) (second form);
spicery, i.e. (generally) valuables probably for H5219 (נְכֹאת);
to complete apparently a primitive root;
despised from H959 (בָּזָה),
Nemuel, the name of two Israelites apparently for H3223 (יְמוּאֵל);
a Nemuelite, or descendant of Nemuel from H5241 (נְמוּאֵל);
to become clipped or (specifically) circumcised a primitive root;
an ant (probably from its almost bisected form) feminine from H5243 (נָמַל);
{a leopard (from its stripes)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5246 (נָמֵר)
a leopard (from its stripes) from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid (comp H5247 (נִמְרָה) and H5249 (נִמְרִים)); and thus to spot or stain as if by dripping;

term: Nimrah. See also H1039 (בֵּית נִמְרָה), H5249 (נִמְרִים).

Nimrod, a son of Cush or נִמְרֹד; probably of foreign origin;
Nimrim, a place East of the Jordan plural of a masculine corresponding to H5247 (נִמְרָה); clear waters;
Nimshi, the (grand-) father of Jehu probably from H4871 (מָשָׁה); extricated;
a flag; also a sail; by implication, a flagstaff; generally a signal; figuratively, a token from H5264 (נָסַס);
properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs feminine participle passive of H5437 (סָבַב);

term: departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.
definition: to retreat a primitive root;
to test; by implication, to attempt a primitive root;
to tear away a primitive root;
{to tear away} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5255 (נָסַח)
properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation; also a molten image; by implication, a prince (as anointed) from H5258 (נָסַךְ);

term: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).
definition: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking a primitive root;
to interweave, i.e. (figuratively) to overspread a primitive root (probably identical with H5258 (נָסַךְ) through the idea of fusion);
to pour out a libation (Aramaic) corresponding to H5258 (נָסַךְ);
a libation (Aramaic) corresponding to H5262 (נֶסֶךְ);
a libation; also a cast idol or נֵסֶךְ; from H5258 (נָסַךְ);
to wane, i.e. be sick a primitive root;
