term: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.
definition: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney a primitive root;
to go up a primitive root;
{to go up} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5266 (נָסַק)
Nisrok, a Babylonian idol of foreign origin;
Neah, a place in Palestine from H5128 (נוּעַ); motion;
Noah, an Israelitess from H5128 (נוּעַ); movement;

(only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people) or נָעֻר; and (feminine) נְעֻרָה; properly, passive participle from H5288 (נַעַר) as denominative;
Neiel, a place in Palestine from H5128 (נוּעַ) and H410 (אֵל); moved of God;
delightful (objective or subjective, literal or figurative) from H5276 (נָעֵם);

term: bolt, inclose, lock, shoe, shut up.
definition: properly, to fasten up, i.e. with abar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers a primitive root; also denominative from H5275 (נַעַל)
properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless) or (feminine) נַעֲלָה; from H5274 (נָעַל);

term: pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.
definition: to be agreeable (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
Naam, an Israelite from H5276 (נָעֵם); pleasure;
agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace from H5276 (נָעֵם);
Naamah, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine feminine of H5277 (נַעַם); pleasantness;
a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively) patronymic from H5283 (נַעֲמָן);
Noomi, an Israelitess from H5278 (נֹעַם); pleasant;
pleasantness (plural as concrete) from H5276 (נָעֵם);
Naaman, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene the same as H5282 (נַעֲמָן);
a Naamathite, or inhabitant of Naamah patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with H5279 (נַעֲמָה);
probably a brier; by implication, a thicket of thorny bushes from an unused root meaning to prick;
to growl a primitive root;

term: shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.
definition: to tumble about a primitive root (probably identical with H5286 (נָעַר), through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion's roar);

term: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).
definition: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age) from H5287 (נָעַר);
a wanderer from H5287 (נָעַר) in its derivative sense of tossing about;
(abstractly) boyhood from H5287 (נָעַר); (compare H5288 (נַעַר))
a girl (from infancy to adolescence) feminine of H5288 (נַעַר);
Naarah, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine the same as H5291 (נַעֲרָה);
Naarai, an Israelite from H5288 (נַעַר); youthful;
Nearjah, the name of two Israelites from H5288 (נַעַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); servant of Jah;
Naaran, a place in Palestine from H5288 (נַעַר); juvenile;
something shaken out, i.e. tow (as the refuse of flax) from H5287 (נָעַר);
Noph, the capital of Upper Egypt a variation of H4644 (מֹף);
Nepheg, the name of two Israelites from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth; a sprout;
a height; also a sieve from H5130 (נוּף) in the sense of lifting;
Nephushesim, a Temple-servant for H5304 (נְפִיסִים);

term: blow, breath, give up, cause to lose (life), seething, snuff.
definition: to puff, in various applications (literally, to inflate, blow hard, scatter, kindle, expire; figuratively, to disesteem) a primitive root;
Nophach, a place in Moab from H5301 (נָפַח); a gust;
properly, a feller, i.e. a bully or tyrant or נְפִל; from H5307 (נָפַל);
Nephisim, a Temple-servant plural from an unused root meaning to scatter; expansions;
Naphish, a son of Ishmael, and his posterity from H5314 (נָפַשׁ); refreshed;
shining; a gem, probably the garnet from an unused root meaning to glisten;

term: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.
definition: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative) a primitive root;
{to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5307 (נָפַל)
something fallen, i.e. an abortion or נֵפֶל; from H5307 (נָפַל);

term: be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.
definition: to dash to pieces, or scatter a primitive root;
a storm (as dispersing) from H5310 (נָפַץ);
to issue; causatively, to bring out (Aramaic) a primitive root;
an outgo, i.e. expense (Aramaic) from H5312 (נְפַק);
to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon , i.e. (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air) a primitive root;

term: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.
definition: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental) from H5314 (נָפַשׁ);
a height for H5299 (נָפָה);
a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb) from H5130 (נוּף) in the sense of shaking to pieces;
Nephtoach, a place in Palestine from H6605 (פָּתַח); opened, i.e. a spring;
properly, wrestled; but used (in the plural) transitively, a struggle from H6617 (פָּתַל);
Naphtuchim, an Egyptian tribe plural of foreign origin,
Naphtali, a son of Jacob, with the tribe descended from him, and its territory from H6617 (פָּתַל); my wrestling;
a flower (from its brilliancy); also a hawk (from it flashing speed) from H5340 (נָצַץ);
to go away a primitive root;

term: appointed, deputy, erect, establish, [idiom] Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.
definition: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
fixed, i.e. a handle passive participle of H5324 (נָצַב);
fixedness, i.e. firmness (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5324 (נָצַב);
properly, to go forth, i.e. (by implication) to be expelled, and (consequently) desolate; causatively, to lay waste; also (specifically), to quarrel a primitive root;
a blossom feminine of H5322 (נֵץ);

term: excel, chief musician (singer), oversee(-r), set forward.
definition: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent a primitive root;  also as denominative from H5331 (נֶצַח)
to become chief (Aramaic) corresponding to H5329 (נָצַח);

term: alway(-s), constantly, end, ([phrase] n-) ever(more), perpetual, strength, victory.
definition: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view) or נֵצַח; from H5329 (נָצַח);
juice of the grape (as blood red) probably identical with H5331 (נֶצַח), through the idea of brilliancy of color;
something stationary, i.e. a prefect, a military post, a statue or נְצִב; from H5324 (נָצַב);
Netsib, a place in Palestine the same as H5333 (נְצִיב); station;
Netsiach, a Temple-servant from H5329 (נָצַח); conspicuous;
properly, conservative; but used passively, delivered from H5341 (נָצַר);

term: [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
definition: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense a primitive root;
to extricate (Aramaic) corresponding to H5337 (נָצַל);
a blossom from H5322 (נֵץ);
to glare, i.e. be bright-colored a primitive root;

term: besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).
definition: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.) a primitive root;
a shoot; figuratively, a descendant from H5341 (נָצַר) in the sense of greenness as a striking color;
clean (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5352 (נָקָה);

term: appoint, blaspheme, bore, curse, express, with holes, name, pierce, strike through.
definition: to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel) a primitive root;
a bezel (for a gem)
Nekeb, a place in Palestine the same as H5345 (נֶקֶב); dell;
female (from the sexual form) from H5344 (נָקַב);
spotted from an unused root meaning to mark (by puncturing or branding);
a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them) active participle from the same as H5348 (נָקֹד);
a crumb (as broken to spots); also a biscuit (as pricked) from the same as H5348 (נָקֹד);
a boss feminine of H5348 (נָקֹד);

term: acquit [idiom] at all, [idiom] altogether, be blameless, cleanse, (be) clear(-ing), cut off, be desolate, be free, be (hold) guiltless, be (hold) innocent, [idiom] by no means, be quit, be (leave) unpunished, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] wholly.
definition: to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated a primitive root;
Nekoda, a Temple-servant feminine of H5348 (נָקֹד) (in the figurative sense of marked); distinction;
to loathe a primitive root;

term: blameless, clean, clear, exempted, free, guiltless, innocent, quit.
definition: innocent or נָקִיא; (Joel 4:19; Jonah [1:14), from H5352 (נָקָה);
clearness (literally or figuratively) or נִקָּיֹן; from H5352 (נָקָה);
a cleft from an unused root meaning to bore;

term: avenge(-r, self), punish, revenge (self), [idiom] surely, take vengeance.
definition: to grudge, i.e. avenge or punish a primitive root;
revenge from H5358 (נָקַם);
avengement, whether the act of the passion feminine of H5359 (נָקָם);
to feel aversion a primitive root;

term: compass (about, -ing), cut down, destroy, go round (about), inclose, round.
definition: to strike with more or less violence (beat, fell, corrode); by implication (of attack) to knock together, i.e. surround or circulate a primitive root;
a threshing (of olives) from H5362 (נָקַף);
probably a rope (as encircling) from H5362 (נָקַף);

term: dig, pick out, pierce, put (thrust) out.
definition: to bore (penetrate, quarry) a primitive root;
{to bore (penetrate, quarry)} from H5365 (נָקַר), a fissure
to entrap (with a noose), literally or figuratively a primitive root;
to knock (Aramaic) corresponding to H5367 (נָקַשׁ); used in the sense of H5362 (נָקַף);
Ner, an Israelite the same as H5216 (נִיר); lamp;
Nergal, a Cuthite deity of foreign origin;
Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians from H5370 (נֵרְגַּל) and H8272 (שַׁרְאֶצֶר);
a slanderer from an unused root meaning to roll to pieces;
nard, an aromatic of foreign origin;
Nerijah, an Israelite or נֵרִיָּהוּ; from H5216 (נִיר) and H3050 (יָהּ); light of Jah;

term: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.
definition: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative or נָסָה; (Psalm 4:6 (H7 (אֲבַד))), a primitive root;
{to lift} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5375 (נָשָׂא)
to lead astray, i.e. (mentally) to delude, or (morally) to seduce a primitive root;
to lend on interest; by implication, to dun fordebt a primitive root (perhaps identical with H5377 (נָשָׁא), through the idea of imposition);
something taken, i.e. a present passive participle feminine of H5375 (נָשָׂא);
to blow; by implication, to disperse a primitive root;

term: ability, be able, attain (unto), (be able to, can) get, lay at, put, reach, remove, wax rich, [idiom] surely, (over-) take (hold of, on, upon).
definition: to reach (literally or figuratively) a primitive root;
to forget; figuratively, to neglect; causatively, to remit, remove a primitive root;

term: creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker on) usury.
definition: to lend or (by reciprocity) borrow on security or interest a primitive root (rather identical with H5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of H5378 (נָשָׁא));
rheumatic or crippled (from the incident to Jacob) from H5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of failure;
something borne, i.e. a load or rather, נְשֻׂאָה; feminine. passive participle of H5375 (נָשָׂא);
a debt from H5383 (נָשָׁה);

term: captain, chief, cloud, governor, prince, ruler, vapour.
definition: properly, an exalted one, i.e. a king or sheik; also a rising mist or נָשִׂא; from H5375 (נָשָׂא);
oblivion from H5382 (נָשָׁה);
{a man} (Aramaic) irregular plural feminine of H606 (אֱנָשׁ)
a kiss from H5401 (נָשַׁק);
to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan a primitive root;
interest on a debt from H5391 (נָשַׁךְ);
a cell for H3957 (לִשְׁכָּה);

term: cast (out), drive, loose, put off (out), slip.
definition: to pluck off, i.e. divest, eject or drop a primitive root;
properly, to blow away, i.e. destroy a primitive root;
vital breath (Aramaic) corresponding to H5397 (נְשָׁמָה);
a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal from H5395 (נָשַׁם);
to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind) a primitive root;

term: dark, dawning of the day (morning), night, twilight.
definition: properly, a breeze, i.e. (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails) from H5398 (נָשַׁף);
to catch fire a primitive root;

to kiss, literally or figuratively (touch); also (as a mode of attachment), to equip with weapons a primitive root (identical with H5400 (נָשַׂק), through the idea of fastening up; compare H2388 (חָזַק), H2836 (חָשַׁק));

term: armed men, armour(-y), battle, harness, weapon.
definition: military equipment, i.e. (collectively) arms (offensive or defensive), or (concretely) an arsenal or נֵשֶׁק; from H5401 (נָשַׁק);
an eagle (Aramaic) corresponding to H5404 (נֶשֶׁר);
the eagle (or other large bird of prey) from an unused root meaning to lacerate;
properly, to eliminate, i.e. (intransitively) to dry up a primitive root;
an epistle probably of Persian origin;
{an epistle} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5406 (נִשְׁתְּוָן)

term: cut (in pieces), divide, hew in pieces.
definition: to dismember a primitive root;
a fragment from H5408 (נָתַח);
a (beaten) track or (feminine) נְתִיבָה; or נְתִבָה; (Jeremiah 6:16), from an unused root meaning to tramp;
the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty) or נָתוּן (Ezra 8:17), (the proper form as passive participle), from H5414 (נָתַן); one given, i.e. (in the plural only)
{the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5411 (נָתִין)
to flow forth (literally or figuratively); by implication, to liquify a primitive root;

term: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.
definition: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.) a primitive root;
give (Aramaic) corresponding to H5414 (נָתַן);
Nathan, the name of five Israelites from H5414 (נָתַן); given;
Nethanel, the name of ten Israelites from H5414 (נָתַן) and H410 (אֵל); given of God;
Nethanjah, the name of four Israelites or נְתַנְיָהוּ; from H5414 (נָתַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); given of Jah;
Nethan-Melek, an Israelite from H5414 (נָתַן) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); given of (the) king;
to tear up a primitive root;
to tear out for H5422 (נָתַץ);

term: beat down, break down (out), cast down, destroy, overthrow, pull down, throw down.
definition: to tear down a primitive root;

term: break (off), burst, draw (away), lift up, pluck (away, off), pull (out), root out.
definition: to tear off a primitive root;
scurf from H5423 (נָתַק);

term: drive asunder, leap, (let) loose, [idiom] make, move, undo.
definition: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie a primitive root;
{to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5425 (נָתַר)
mineral potash (so called from effervescing with acid) from H5425 (נָתַר);

term: destroy, forsake, pluck (out, up, by the roots), pull up, root out (up), [idiom] utterly. s
definition: to tear away a primitive root;
a seah, or certain measure (as determinative) forgrain from an unused root meaning to define;
perhaps a military boot (as aprotection from mud from H5431 (סָאַן);
to shoe, i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod a primitive root; to be miry; used only as denominative from H5430 (סְאוֹן);
measurement, i.e. moderation for H5429 (סְאָה);
to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy a primitive root;
Seba, a son of Cush, and the country settled by him of foreign origin;
potation, concretely (wine), or abstractly (carousal) from H5433 (סָבָא);
a Sebaite, or inhabitant of Seba patrial from H5434 (סְבָא);

term: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).
definition: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively a primitive root;
a (providential) turn (of affairs) from H5437 (סָבַב);

term: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.
definition: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around or (feminine) סְבִיבָה; from H5437 (סָבַב);
to entwine a primitive root;
a copse from H5440 (סָבַךְ);
a copse from H5440 (סָבַךְ),
a lyre (Aramaic) or שַׂבְּכָא; (Aramaic), from a root corresponding to H5440 (סָבַךְ);
Sibbecai, an Israelite from H5440 (סָבַךְ); copse-like;

term: bear, be a burden, carry, strong to labour.
definition: to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid a primitive root;
to erect (Aramaic) corresponding to H5445 (סָבַל);
a load (literally or figuratively) from H5445 (סָבַל);
a load (figuratively) (only in the form סֻבָּל; from H5445 (סָבַל);
a porter from H5445 (סָבַל);
porterage from H5447 (סֵבֶל);
an ear of grain for H7641 (שִׁבֹּל);
to bear in mind, i.e. hope (Aramaic) a primitive root;
Sibrajim, a place in Syria dual from a root corresponding to H5452 (סְבַר); double hope;
Sabta or Sabtah, the name of a son of Cush, and the country occupied by his posterity or סַבְתָּה; probably of foreign derivation;
Sabteca, the name of a son of Cush, and the region settled by him probably of foreign derivation;
to prostrate oneself (in homage) a primitive root;
{to prostrate oneself (in homage)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5456 (סָגַד)
properly, shut up, i.e. the breast (as enclosing the heart); also gold (as generally shut up safely) from H5462 (סָגַר);
wealth (as closely shut up) feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to shut up;
{a prefect of aprovince} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5461 (סָגָן)
a prefect of a province from an unused root meaning to superintend;

term: close up, deliver (up), give over (up), inclose, [idiom] pure, repair, shut (in, self, out, up, up together), stop, [idiom] straitly.
definition: to shut up; figuratively, to surrender a primitive root;
{to shut up; figuratively, to surrender} (Aramaic) corresponding to H5462 (סָגַר)
a pouring rain probably from H5462 (סָגַר) in the sense of sweeping away;
the stocks from an unused root meaning to estop;
a wrapper, i.e. shirt from an unused root meaning to envelop;
Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea from an unused root meaning to scorch; burnt (i.e. volcanic or bituminous) district;
order from an unused root meaning to arrange;
roundness from an unused root meaning to be round;
a dungeon (as surrounded by walls) from the same as H5469 (סַהַר);
So, an Egyptian king of foreign derivation;

term: backslider, drive, go back, turn (away, back).
definition: properly, to flinch, i.e. (by implication) to go back, literally (to retreat) or figuratively (to apostatize) a primitive root;
to hem in, i.e. bind a primitive root (probably rather identical with H5472 (סוּג) through the idea of shrinking from a hedge; compare H7735 (שׂוּג));
an inclosure, i.e. cage (for an animal) from H5462 (סָגַר);
a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret from H3245 (יָסַד);
Sodi, an Israelite from H5475 (סוֹד); a confidant;
Suach, an Israelite from an unused root meaning to wipe away; sweeping;
something swept away, i.e. filth from the same as H5477 (סוּחַ);
Sotai, one of the Nethinim from H7750 (שׂוּט); roving;
properly, to smear over (with oil), i.e. anoint a primitive root;
a bagpipe (with a double pipe) (Aramaic) or סוּמְפֹּנְיָה; (Aramaic), or סִיפֹנְיָא; (Daniel 3:10) (Aramaic), of Greek origin;
Seven, a place in Upper Egypt (rather to be written סְוֵנָה; for סְוֵן; i.e to Seven); of Egyptian derivation;
a horse (as leaping); also a swallow (from its rapid flight) or סֻס; from an unused root meaning to skip (properly, for joy);

a stock (Aramaic) from H6132 (עֲקַר);
a scorpion; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip of uncertain derivation;
Ekron, a place in Palestine from H6131 (עָקַר); eradication;
an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron or עֶקְרֹנִי; patrial from H6138 (עֶקְרוֹן);
to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse) a primitive root;
distorted; hence, false from H6140 (עָקַשׁ);
Ikkesh, an Israelite the same as H6141 (עִקֵּשׁ); perverse;
perversity from H6141 (עִקֵּשׁ);
Ar, a place in Moab the same as H5892 (עִיר); a city;
a foe (as watchful for mischief) from H5782 (עוּר);
{a foe (as watchful for mischief)} (Aramaic) corresponding to H6145 (עָר)
Er, the name of two Israelites from H5782 (עוּר); watchful;

term: engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.
definition: to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange) a primitive root;

term: be pleasant(-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.
definition: to be agreeable a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of close association);
to grow dusky at sundown a primitive root (rather identical with H6148 (עָרַב) through the idea of covering with a texture);
to commingle (Aramaic) corresponding to H6148 (עָרַב);
Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine or עֲרַב; from H6150 (עָרַב) in the figurative sense of sterility;
dusk from H6150 (עָרַב);
the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race) or עֶרֶב; (1 Kings 10:15), (with the article [prefix), from H6148 (עָרַב);
a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles) from H6148 (עָרַב);
pleasant from H6149 (עָרֵב);
a mosquito (from its swarming) from H6148 (עָרַב);
a raven (from its dusky hue) or עוֹרֵב; from H6150 (עָרַב);
Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan or עוֹרֵב; the same as H6158 (עֹרֵב);

term: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה).
definition: a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea from H6150 (עָרַב) (in the sense of sterility);
something given as security, i.e. (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman feminine passive participle of H6048 (עֲנַמֶּלֶךְ) in the sense of a bargain or exchange;
a pawn (given as security) from H6148 (עָרַב) (in the sense of exchange);
an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia) or עַרְבִי; patrial from H6152 (עֲרָב);
an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah patrial from H1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה);
to long for a primitive root;
Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite from an unused root meaning to sequester itself; fugitive;
an onager (Aramaic) corresponding to H6171 (עָרוֹד);

term: leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.
definition: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish a primitive root;
a naked (i.e. level) plot feminine from H6168 (עָרָה);
something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre or עֲרֻגָה; feminine passive participle of H6165 (עָרַג);
an onager (from his lonesome habits) from the same as H6166 (עֲרָד);
nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish) from H6168 (עָרָה);
nakedness, i.e. (figuratively) impoverishment (Aramaic) corresponding to H6172 (עֶרְוָה);
nude, either partially or totally or עָרֹם; from H6191 (עָרַם) (in its original sense);
cunning (usually in a bad sense) passive participle of H6191 (עָרַם);
a juniper (from its nudity of situation) or עַרְעָר; from H6209 (עָרַר) reduplicated;
Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine or עֲרֹעֵר; or עַרְעוֹר; the same as H6176 (עֲרוֹעֵר); nudity of situation;
feared, i.e. (concretely) a horrible place or chasm passive participle of H6206 (עָרַץ);
Eri, an Israelite from H5782 (עוּר); watchful;
a Erite (collectively) or descendants of Eri patronymically of H6179 (עֵרִי);
nudity for H6172 (עֶרְוָה);
meal from an unused root meaning to comminute;
the sky (as dropping at the horizon) from H6201 (עָרַף);

term: mighty, oppressor, in great power, strong, terrible, violent.
definition: fearful, i.e. powerful or tyrannical from H6206 (עָרַץ);
bare, i.e. destitute (of children) from H6209 (עָרַר);

term: put (set) (the battle, self) in array, compare, direct, equal, esteem, estimate, expert (in war), furnish, handle, join (battle), ordain, (lay, put, reckon up, set) (in) order, prepare, tax, value.
definition: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications) a primitive root;

term: equal, estimation, (things that are set in) order, price, proportion, [idiom] set at, suit, taxation, [idiom] valuest.
definition: a pile, equipment, estimate from H6186 (עָרַךְ);

term: count uncircumcised, foreskin to be uncovered.
definition: to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literal (to go naked) or figurative (to refrain from using) a primitive root; properly, to strip; but used as denominative from H6189 (עָרֵל);
uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed) from H6188 (עָרֵל); properly, exposed, i.e. projecting loose (as to the prepuce); used only technically,
the prepuce feminine of H6189 (עָרֵל);

term: [idiom] very, beware, take crafty (counsel), be prudent, deal subtilly.
definition: properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense) a primitive root;
to pile up a primitive root;
a stratagem from H6191 (עָרַם);
a heap; specifically, a sheaf (Jeremiah 50:26) or (feminine) עֲרֵמָה; from H6192 (עָרַם);
trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion feminine of H6193 (עֹרֶם);
the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark) probably from H6191 (עָרַם);
Eran, an Israelite probably from H5782 (עוּר); watchful;
an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran patronymically from H6197 (עֵרָן);
naked, i.e. (figuratively) poor from H6209 (עָרַר);
an Aroerite or inhabitant of Aroer patronymically from H6177 (עֲרוֹעֵר);
to droop; hence, to drip a primitive root;

term: that is beheaded, break down, break (cut off, strike off) neck.
definition: to break the neck; hence (figuratively) to destroy a primitive root (identical with through the idea of sloping); properly, to bend downward; but used only as a denominative from H6203 (עֹרֶף),
the nape or back of the neck (as declining); hence, the back generally (whether literal or figurative) from H6202 (עָרַף);
Orpah, a Moabites feminine of H6203 (עֹרֶף); mane;
gloom (as of a lowering sky) probably from H6201 (עָרַף);

term: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
definition: to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass a primitive root;
to gnaw, i.e. (figuratively) eat (by hyberbole); also (participle) a pain a primitive root;
an Arkite or inhabitant of Erek patrial from an unused name meaning a tush;

term: make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), [idiom] utterly.
definition: to bare; figuratively, to demolish a primitive root;
a couch (properly, with a canopy) from an unused root meaning perhaps to arch;
a moth from H6244 (עָשֵׁשׁ);
grass (or any tender shoot) from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green);

term: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.
definition: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application a primitive root;
Asahel, the name of four Israelites from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H410 (אֵל); God has made;
Esav, a son of Isaac, including his posterity apparently a form of the passive participle of H6213 (עָשָׂה) in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt);
oppressive (as noun, a tyrant) from H6231 (עָשַׁק);
used in plural masculine as abstractly, tyranny or עָשֻׁק; passive participle of H6231 (עָשַׁק);
ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord or עָשֹׂר; from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
shining, i.e. polished from H6245 (עָשַׁת);
Ashvath, an Israelite for H6219 (עָשׁוֹת); bright;
Asiel, an Israelite from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H410 (אֵל); made of God;
Asajah, the name of three or four Israelites from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has made;
rich, whether literal or figurative (noble) from H6238 (עָשַׁר);
tenth; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
to smoke, whether literal or figurative a primitive root;
smoky from H6225 (עָשַׁן);
smoke, literally or figuratively (vapor, dust, anger) from H6225 (עָשַׁן);
Ashan, a place in Palestine the same as H6227 (עָשָׁן);
to press upon, i.e. quarrel a primitive root (identical with H6231 (עָשַׁק));
strife from H6229 (עָשַׂק);

term: get deceitfully, deceive, defraud, drink up, (use) oppress(-ion), -or), do violence (wrong).
definition: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow a primitive root (compare H6229 (עָשַׂק));
Eshek, an Israelite from H6231 (עָשַׁק); oppression;
injury, fraud, (subjectively) distress, (concretely) unjust gain from H6231 (עָשַׁק);
anguish feminine of H6233 (עֹשֶׁק);
ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits) masculine of term עֲשָׂרָה; from H6237 (עָשַׂר);
ten (Aramaic) masculine עֲשְׂרָה (Aramaic); corresponding to H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);

term: [idiom] surely, give (take) the tenth, (have, take) tithe(-ing, -s), [idiom] truly.
definition: to tithe, i.e. to take or give atenth a primitive root (identical with H6238 (עָשַׁר)); to accumulate; but used only as denominative from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);

term: be(-come, en-, make, make self, wax) rich, make (1 Kings 22:48 marg). See H6240 (עָשָׂר).
definition: properly, to accumulate; chiefly (specifically) to grow (causatively, make) rich a primitive root;
wealth from H6238 (עָשַׁר);

term: (eigh-, fif-, four-, nine-, seven-, six-, thir-) teen(-th), [phrase] eleven(-th), [phrase] sixscore thousand, [phrase] twelve(-th).
definition: ten (only in combination), i.e. -teen; also (ordinal) -teenth for H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
(fractional) a tenth part or עִשָּׂרֹן; from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth from H6235 (עֶשֶׂר);
{twenty; also (ordinal) twentieth} (Aramaic) corresponding to H6242 (עֶשְׂרִים)
probably to shrink, i.e. fail a primitive root;
probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind) a primitive root;
to purpose (Aramaic) corresponding to H6245 (עָשַׁת);
a fabric from H6245 (עָשַׁת);
cogitation from H6245 (עָשַׁת);
eleven or (ordinal) eleventh apparently masculine plural construction of H6247 (עֶשֶׁת) in the sense of an afterthought (used only in connection with H6240 (עָשָׂר) in lieu of H259 (אֶחָד))
thinking from H6245 (עָשַׁת);
increase probably from H6238 (עָשַׁר);

term: Asharoth, Astaroth. See also H1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), H6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).
definition: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan or עַשְׁתָּרֹת; plural of H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה);
Ashtoreth, the Phoenician goddess of love (and increase) probably for H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה);
an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth patrial from H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת);
Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan from H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת) and the dual of H7161 (קֶרֶן); Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity);

term: [phrase] after, (al-) ways, [idiom] certain, [phrase] continually, [phrase] evening, long, (due) season, so (long) as, (even-, evening-, noon-) tide, (meal-), what) time, when.
definition: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc. from H5703 (עַד);

term: make fit, be ready to become.
definition: to prepare a primitive root;

term: henceforth, now, straightway, this time, whereas.
definition: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive from H6256 (עֵת);
prepared passive participle of H6257 (עָתַד);
prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people or עַתֻּד; from H6257 (עָתַד);
timely from H6256 (עֵת);
Attai, the name of three Israelites for H6261 (עִתִּי);
prepared (Aramaic) corresponding to H6264 (עָתִיד);

term: things that shall come, ready, treasures.
definition: prepared; by implication, skilful; feminine plural the future; also treasure from H6257 (עָתַד);
Athajah, an Israelite from H5790 (עוּת) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has helped;
properly, antique, i.e. venerable or splendid from H6275 (עָתַק);
removed, i.e. weaned; also antique from H6275 (עָתַק);
venerable (Aramaic) corresponding to H6267 (עַתִּיק);
Athak, a place in Palestine from an unused root meaning to sojourn; lodging;
Athlai, an Israelite from an unused root meaning to compress; constringent;
Athaljah, the name of an Israelitess and two Israelites or עֲתַלְיָהוּ; from the same as H6270 (עַתְלַי) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has constrained;
probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated a primitive root;
Othni, an Israelite from an unused root meaning to force; forcible;
Othniel, an Israelite from the same as H6273 (עׇתְנִי) and H410 (אֵל); force of God;

term: copy out, leave off, become (wax) old, remove.
definition: to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe a primitive root;
antique, i.e. valued from H6275 (עָתַק);
impudent from H6275 (עָתַק) in the sense of license;
Eth-Katsin, a place in Palestine from H6256 (עֵת) and H7011 (קַיָּם); time of a judge;
to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer) a primitive root (rather denominative from H6281 (עֶתֶר));
to be (causatively, make) abundant a primitive root;
Ether, a place in Palestine from H6280 (עָתַר); abundance;
incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence  a worshipper from H6280 (עָתַר); also compare H6279 (עָתַר)
copiousness from H6280 (עָתַר);
to puff, i.e. blow away a primitive root;
properly, mouth in a figurative sense, i.e. direction, region, extremity feminine of H6311 (פֹּה);

term: beautify, boast self, go over the boughs, glorify (self), glory, vaunt self.
definition: to gleam, i.e. (causatively) embellish; figuratively, to boast; also to explain (i.e. make clear) oneself; to shake a tree a primitive root; also denominative from H6288 (פְּאֹרָה),
an embellishment, i.e. fancy head-dress from H6286 (פָּאַר);
properly, ornamentation, i.e. (plural) foliage (including the limbs) as bright green or פֹּרָאה; or פֻּארָה; from H6286 (פָּאַר);
properly, illuminated, i.e. a glow; as noun, a flush (of anxiety) from H6286 (פָּאַר);
Paran, a desert of Arabia from H6286 (פָּאַר); ornamental;
crude; an unripe fig from an unused root meaning to be torpid, i.e.
properly, fetid, i.e. (figuratively) unclean (ceremonially) or פִּגֻּל; from an unused root meaning to stink;

term: come (betwixt), cause to entreat, fall (upon), make intercession, intercessor, intreat, lay, light (upon), meet (together), pray, reach, run.
definition: to impinge, by accident or violence, or (figuratively) by importunity a primitive root;
impact (casual) from H6293 (פָּגַע);
Pagiel, an Israelite from H6294 (פֶּגַע) and H410 (אֵל); accident of God;
to relax, i.e. become exhausted a primitive root;
a carcase (as limp), whether of man or beast; figuratively, an idolatrous image from H6296 (פָּגַר);
to come in contact with, whether by accident or violence; figuratively, to concur a primitive root;

term: [idiom] at all, deliver, [idiom] by any means, ransom, (that are to be, let be) redeem(-ed), rescue, [idiom] surely.
definition: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve a primitive root;
Pedahel, an Israelite from H6299 (פָּדָה) and H410 (אֵל); God has ransomed;
Pedahtsur, an Israelite from H6299 (פָּדָה) and H6697 (צוּר); a rock (i.e. God) has ransomed;
as abstractly (in plural masculine) a ransom passive participle of H6299 (פָּדָה). ransomed (and so occurring under H6299 (פָּדָה));
Padon, one of the Nethinim. from H6299 (פָּדָה); ransom;
distinction; also deliverance or פְּדֻת; from H6929 (קֵדְמָה)lemma קדְמָה missing vowel, corrected to קֵדְמָה;
Pedajah, the name of six Israelites or פְּדָיָהוּ; from H6299 (פָּדָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has ransomed;
a ransom or פִּדְיֹם; also פִּדְיוֹן; or פִּדְיֹן; from H6299 (פָּדָה);
Paddan or Paddan-Aram, a region of Syria from an unused root meaning to extend; a plateau; or פַּדַּן אֲרָם; from the same and H758 (אֲרָם); the table-land of Aram;
to retrieve a primitive root;
suet from an unused root meaning to be greasy;

term: accord(-ing as, -ing to), after, appointment, assent, collar, command(-ment), [idiom] eat, edge, end, entry, [phrase] file, hole, [idiom] in, mind, mouth, part, portion, [idiom] (should) say(-ing), sentence, skirt, sound, speech, [idiom] spoken, talk, tenor, [idiom] to, [phrase] two-edged, wish, word.
definition: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to from H6284 (פָּאָה);

term: here, hither, the one (other, this, that) side.
definition: this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence or פֹּא; (Job 38:11), or פּוֹ; probably from a primitive inseparable particle 'p' (of demonstrative force) and H1931 (הוּא);
Puah or Puvvah, the name of two Israelites or פֻּוָּה; from H6284 (פָּאָה); a blast;

term: cease, be feeble, faint, be slacked.
definition: to be sluggish a primitive root;
intermission from H6313 (פּוּג);

term: blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.
definition: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff a primitive root;
Put, a son of Ham, also the name of his descendants or their region, and of a Persian tribe of foreign origin;
Putiel, an Israelite from an unused root (probably meaning to disparage) and H410 (אֵל); contempt of God;
Potiphar, an Egyptian of Egyptian derivation;
Poti-Phera, an Egyptian of Egyptian derivation;
dye (specifically, stibium for the eyes) from an unused root meaning to paint;
a bean (as plump) from an unused root meaning to be thick;
Pul, the name of an Assyrian king and of an Ethiopian tribe of foreign origin;
be perplexed a primitive root meaning to turn, i.e.
a Punite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Pun patronymically from an unused name meaning a turn;
Punon, a place in the Desert from H6323 (פּוּן); perplexity;
Puah, an Israelitess from an unused root meaning to glitter; brilliancy;

term: break (dash, shake) in (to) pieces, cast (abroad), disperse (selves), drive, retire, scatter (abroad), spread abroad.
definition: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse) a primitive root;
to waver a primitive root;

term: afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.
definition: to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed a primitive root (identical with H6328 (פּוּק) through the idea of dropping out; compare H5312 (נְפַק));
a stumbling-block from H6328 (פּוּק);

term: break, bring to nought, [idiom] utterly take.
definition: to crush a primitive root;
a lot (as by means of a broken piece) also (plural) פּוּרִים; or פֻּרִים; from H6331 (פּוּר);
a wine-press (as crushing the grapes) from H6331 (פּוּר);
Poratha, a son of Haman of Persian origin;

term: grow up, be grown fat, spread selves, be scattered.
definition: to spread; figuratively, act proudly a primitive root;
a Puthite (collectively) or descendants of an unknown Puth patronymically from an unused name meaning a hinge;
pure (gold); hence, gold itself (as refined) from H6338 (פָּזַז);
to refine (gold) a primitive root;
to solidify (as if by refining); also to spring (as if separating the limbs) a primitive root (identical with H6338 (פָּזַז));
to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty a primitive root;
a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina) from H6351 (פָּחַח);

term: be afraid, stand in awe, (be in) fear, make to shake.
definition: to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general a primitive root;
a (sudden) alarm (properly, the object feared, by implication, the feeling) from H6342 (פָּחַד);
